name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to all land-holding farmer families across the country, payable in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts via DBT.
detailed_description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme that provides income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and for domestic needs. Under the scheme, ₹6,000 per year is provided to eligible farmer families payable in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly to bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
application_process: 1. Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in). 2. Click 'New Farmer Registration'. 3. Enter Aadhaar number and state. 4. Fill in personal and land details. 5. Submit and verify via OTP. Alternatively, visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or gram panchayat.
source_name: pmkisan.gov.in (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare)

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
department: Department of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Free LPG connection with first refill and hotplate to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) and other deprived households to replace unclean cooking fuels.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) was launched with the objective of safeguarding the health of women and children by providing them clean cooking fuel - LPG, so that they don't have to compromise their health in smoky kitchens or wander in jungles in search of firewood. Under PMUY 2.0, expanded to cover more categories including migrants.
benefits: Free LPG connection, first LPG refill free, LPG stove/hotplate. Security deposit waived.
documents: BPL ration card or any one of 14 specified documents as alternative
Self-declaration of not having LPG connection
application_process: 1. Visit nearest LPG distributor (HP Gas, Bharat Gas, or Indane). 2. Fill Form KYC1 and Form PMUY. 3. Submit documents. 4. Verification done by distributor. 5. Connection released after approval. Online application at pmuy.gov.in.
source_name: pmuy.gov.in (Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas)

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to bottom 40% economically vulnerable families.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is the world's largest health insurance/ assurance scheme. It provides health cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. Over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) are eligible. The scheme covers pre and post-hospitalization expenses, 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 health coverage per family per year for hospitalization. Covers 1,949 medical procedures. Cashless and paperless treatment at empanelled hospitals. No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
application_process: 1. Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in using your mobile/ration card number. 2. If eligible, generate your Ayushman card at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), empanelled hospital, or via Ayushman app. 3. Show Ayushman card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.
source_name: pmjay.gov.in (National Health Authority)

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit scheme for street vendors to avail affordable working capital loan starting from ₹10,000 to restart livelihoods. Loans up to ₹50,000 available on repayment.
detailed_description: PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit facility scheme for street vendors affected by COVID-19. It provides collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000 (1st loan), ₹20,000 (2nd loan), ₹50,000 (3rd loan) to approximately 50 lakh street vendors. Incentive for digital transactions – up to ₹1,200 per annum. Subsidy of 7% on interest.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd). 7% interest subsidy. Digital transaction incentive up to ₹1,200/year. Credit score building.
documents: Vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body
application_process: 1. Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or via lending institutions. 2. Contact nearest Urban Local Body (ULB) for vending certificate. 3. Approach scheduled commercial banks, MFIs, or NBFCs. 4. Submit application with documents.
source_name: pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople including recognition, skill upgradation, credit support, and market linkage to strengthen their livelihoods.
detailed_description: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme launched for traditional artisans and craftspeople. The scheme provides recognition as Vishwakarma through PM Vishwakarma certificate, skill training (5-7 days basic, 15 days advanced), toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, credit support (collateral-free loans of ₹1 lakh in 1st tranche, ₹2 lakh in 2nd tranche at 5% concessional rate), digital and green incentives, and market linkage.
benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive. Skill training with ₹500/day stipend. Collateral-free loan: ₹1 lakh (1st), ₹2 lakh (2nd) at 5% interest. Digital transaction incentive ₹1/transaction up to ₹100/month. PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card.
application_process: 1. Apply through Common Service Centres (CSC). 2. Visit pmvishwakarma.gov.in. 3. Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) at CSC will register the artisan. 4. Verification by Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body and District Implementation Committee. 5. Certificate issued after approval.
source_name: pmvishwakarma.gov.in (Ministry of MSME)

name: PM MUDRA Yojana – Shishu
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹50,000 for micro-enterprises and small businesses under the Mudra Shishu category to start or expand business activities.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides loans through Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro-enterprises. Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishore: ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh; Tarun: ₹5,00,001 to ₹10 lakh. No collateral required. For manufacturing, trading, and services sector.
benefits: Collateral-free loan up to ₹50,000 (Shishu). No processing fee for Shishu loans. Flexible repayment up to 5 years. MUDRA card for working capital.
documents: Business plan / proof of business activity
application_process: 1. Visit any scheduled commercial bank, MFI, or NBFC. 2. Fill MUDRA loan application form. 3. Submit business plan and documents. 4. Bank processes and disburses loan. Apply online at udyamimitra.in.
source_name: mudra.org.in (Ministry of Finance)

name: National Scholarship Portal – Post-Matric Scholarship (SC Students)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education in India to provide financial assistance to complete higher education.
detailed_description: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students is one of the flagship schemes for SC students. It covers students studying at Post-Matric or Post-Secondary stage in Government/Government-aided educational institutions. Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, study tour charges, thesis typing/printing charges for research scholars.
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement. Maintenance allowance: ₹1,200/month (hostellers) to ₹550/month (day scholars) for degree/post-graduate. Book allowance and study tour charges. Thesis printing charges for research scholars.
application_process: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Fill application form with required details. 3. Upload documents. 4. Submit application. 5. Institute verifies. 6. State/UT verifies and forwards. 7. Scholarship credited to bank account.
source_name: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
description: Scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate studies in colleges and universities, with preference to those from top 20 percentile of Class 12.
detailed_description: Central Sector Scholarship (CSS) for College and University Students is awarded to meritorious students who are in top 20 percentile of their Class 12 board exam. Scholarships are renewed annually subject to satisfactory progress. The scheme covers 82,000 fresh scholarships per year (41,000 boys + 41,000 girls).
benefits: ₹10,000/year for first 3 years (UG). ₹20,000/year for 4th and 5th year (professional courses). ₹20,000/year for PG students.
application_process: 1. Register at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under 'Central Schemes' → CSS. 3. Fill application and upload documents. 4. Submit before deadline (usually October each year). 5. Institute verification. 6. Scholarship credited.
source_name: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for girl children under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign. Offers higher interest rate and tax benefits for securing girl's education and marriage expenses.
detailed_description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is a government-backed savings scheme specifically for girls. Account can be opened for girl child up to 10 years of age by parent/guardian. Minimum deposit ₹250/year, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year. Interest rate: 8.2% p.a. (Q4 FY2024, subject to quarterly revision). Tax benefits under Section 80C. Partial withdrawal allowed at 18 for education. Account matures at 21 years.
benefits: 8.2% p.a. interest (one of the highest for small savings). Tax-free interest and maturity amount. Section 80C deduction up to ₹1.5 lakh/year. Minimum deposit ₹250/year.
documents: Aadhaar card / Passport of girl and guardian
application_process: 1. Visit any post office or authorized bank (SBI, BOB, PNB, etc.). 2. Fill SSY account opening form. 3. Submit documents and initial deposit (minimum ₹250). 4. Account number and passbook issued.
source_name: India Post / Department of Posts

name: PMEGP (PM Employment Generation Programme)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector to generate employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.
detailed_description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises. For General Category: 15% subsidy (urban), 25% (rural). For SC/ST/Women/differently-abled/NE States/Hill/Border: 25% subsidy (urban), 35% (rural). Maximum project cost: ₹50 lakh (manufacturing), ₹20 lakh (service). Own contribution: 10% for general, 5% for special categories.
benefits: Subsidy: 15-35% of project cost. Maximum project: ₹50 lakh (manufacturing), ₹20 lakh (service). No collateral for loans up to ₹10 lakh under CGTMSE.
application_process: 1. Register at kviconline.gov.in/pmegp. 2. Fill online application. 3. Submit to KVIC/KVIB/DIC. 4. Score card prepared. 5. Interview before task force committee. 6. Loan from bank. 7. Subsidy released to bank.
source_name: kviconline.gov.in (KVIC / Ministry of MSME)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing for All scheme providing financial assistance to urban poor for construction/acquisition of pucca house with basic amenities. Covers EWS, LIG, and MIG categories.
detailed_description: PMAY-U aims to provide housing for all in urban areas by 2024. Benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) – interest subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG. In-situ slum redevelopment. Affordable housing in partnership. Beneficiary-led construction. EWS: Annual income up to ₹3 lakh, LIG: ₹3-6 lakh, MIG-I: ₹6-12 lakh, MIG-II: ₹12-18 lakh.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loan: EWS/LIG up to ₹2.67 lakh. Preference to women as property owner. SC/ST/differently-abled/minorities given preference. Beneficiary-led construction subsidy of ₹1.5 lakh.
documents: Swachh Bharat Mission toilet registration (if applicable)
application_process: 1. Visit PMAY-U portal at pmaymis.gov.in. 2. Check eligibility. 3. Apply via Urban Local Body (ULB) or online portal. 4. For CLSS: Apply through empanelled Primary Lending Institutions (PLIs). 5. Submit documents. 6. Subsidy credited to loan account.
source_name: pmaymis.gov.in (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
description: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers to provide guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60.
detailed_description: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) focuses on the unorganized sector workers. Under APY, a subscriber receives a fixed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60, depending on contribution amount. Government contributes 50% of subscriber's contribution (max ₹1,000/year) for 5 years for those who joined before March 2016. Account holders should not be income tax payers (from 2022 onwards).
benefits: Guaranteed pension ₹1,000-₹5,000/month from age 60. Spouse continues pension on subscriber's death. Nominee receives accumulated pension wealth on death. Tax benefit under Section 80CCD.
application_process: 1. Visit any bank branch, post office, or apply online via net banking. 2. Fill APY subscriber registration form. 3. Link savings bank account for auto-debit of contributions. 4. Account opened and contribution auto-debited monthly.
source_name: pfrda.org.in (PFRDA / Ministry of Finance)

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh coverage for accidental/natural death at an annual premium of just ₹436. Available to individuals aged 18-50 with a bank account.
detailed_description: PMJJBY offers life insurance of ₹2 lakh for one year renewable term at premium of ₹436 per year. It covers death due to any cause. The premium is auto-debited from the bank account. Available to people having a bank/post office savings account in the age group 18-50 years. Renewable every year on June 1.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover for death due to any reason. Annual premium: ₹436 (auto-debited). Simple enrollment through bank.
application_process: 1. Visit your bank branch or apply via net banking/mobile banking. 2. Fill consent-cum-declaration form. 3. Auto-debit of ₹436 from bank account annually. 4. Insurance coverage active for one year (June 1 to May 31).
source_name: jansuraksha.gov.in (Ministry of Finance)

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accidental death and disability insurance scheme providing ₹2 lakh coverage at an annual premium of just ₹20 for people aged 18-70.
detailed_description: PMSBY offers accidental death and disability insurance of ₹2 lakh at annual premium of ₹20. ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. The premium is auto-debited from bank account. Available to people aged 18-70 with a bank/post office savings account. Annual renewal on June 1.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability. ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. Annual premium only ₹20.
application_process: 1. Visit bank branch or apply via net banking/mobile banking. 2. Give consent for auto-debit. 3. ₹20 debited annually. 4. Coverage active June 1 to May 31.
source_name: jansuraksha.gov.in (Ministry of Finance)

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
description: Scholarship for meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropout rate at Class 8 and encourage them to continue secondary and higher secondary education.
detailed_description: NMMS is awarded to students studying in Class 9 to 12 in government/government-aided/local body schools. Selected through State-level Means-cum-Merit examination. One lakh scholarships are awarded every year. Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000/month) disbursed through DBT.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) via DBT. For students in Class 9-12. Renewable annually.
application_process: 1. Appear in NMMS examination conducted by State/UT in November. 2. If selected, register at scholarships.gov.in. 3. Apply online with documents. 4. School verification. 5. State authority verification. 6. Scholarship credited.
source_name: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)

name: National Scholarship – Post-Matric for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship for Other Backward Class (OBC) students pursuing post-matriculation studies to provide financial assistance to complete higher education.
detailed_description: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students provides financial assistance to backward class students studying at post-matric or post-secondary stage. Covers tuition fee, maintenance allowance, book allowance, and other charges. Annual income ceiling: ₹1 lakh. State governments implement the scheme.
benefits: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of fees. Varies by state and course. Book allowance included.
application_process: 1. Register at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under 'State Schemes' for your state's OBC scholarship. 3. Upload documents. 4. Submit before deadline. 5. Institute and state verification. 6. Scholarship credited.
source_name: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls (Technical Education)
department: AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)
description: Scholarship to girl students pursuing technical education (degree and diploma) in AICTE-approved institutions. Up to ₹50,000 per year to cover tuition fee and incidental expenses.
detailed_description: AICTE Pragati Scholarship aims to provide assistance to the girl students for pursuing their education in AICTE-approved institutions. 4,000 scholarships are provided annually. One scholarship per family – only one girl beneficiary per family per year. Eligible for degree (₹50,000/year) and diploma (₹30,000/year) level courses.
benefits: ₹50,000/year for degree students. ₹30,000/year for diploma students. Covers tuition fee and incidental expenses. One girl per family.
application_process: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under 'Central Schemes' → AICTE Pragati. 3. Fill form and upload documents. 4. Submit before deadline. 5. Institute verification. 6. Scholarship credited.
source_name: AICTE / National Scholarship Portal

name: PM Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces and Paramilitary
description: Scholarship for wards and widows of CAPF/RPF/RPSF/State Police personnel killed or disabled in action to promote higher technical and professional education.
detailed_description: PM Scholarship Scheme for CAPF/RPF/RPSF provides scholarships to wards and widows of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) and Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel killed or disabled in action or died/disabled due to causes attributable to Govt. service. ₹2,500/month for boys, ₹3,000/month for girls.
benefits: ₹2,500/month for boys. ₹3,000/month for girls. For professional/technical degree courses (min 60% in qualifying exam).
application_process: 1. Apply at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Under 'Central Schemes' → PM Scholarship for CAPF. 3. Upload documents including service certificate. 4. Verification by respective Force HQ. 5. Scholarship credited.
source_name: National Scholarship Portal / Ministry of Home Affairs

name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Loans
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Concessional loans for persons with disabilities for self-employment, education, skill development, and livelihood activities at low interest rates.
detailed_description: NHFDC provides loans at concessional interest rates to persons with disabilities (PwD) for economic development. Term loans for self-employment: 5% p.a. (women with disability: 4% p.a.). Educational loans at 4% p.a. Skill Development loan at 4% p.a. Maximum loan: ₹30 lakh. Implemented through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs).
benefits: Term loan at 5% p.a. (4% for women with disability). Education loan at 4% p.a. Maximum ₹30 lakh. Subsidy component available in some schemes.
application_process: 1. Contact State Channelising Agency (SCA) in your state. 2. Submit loan application with documents. 3. Verification by SCA. 4. Loan sanctioned and disbursed via bank. Visit nhfdc.nic.in for SCA details.
source_name: nhfdc.nic.in (NHFDC / Ministry of Social Justice)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit scheme providing ₹5,000 cash incentive to pregnant and lactating women for first live birth to partially compensate wage loss and improve health and nutrition.
detailed_description: PMMVY provides a cash incentive of ₹5,000 to pregnant women and lactating mothers for the birth of first living child (₹6,000 for 2nd child if girl). Benefit is given in installments linked to antenatal care. Aims to improve health-seeking behavior and provide wage compensation during pregnancy. Implemented through Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: ₹5,000 for first child (in 3 installments). ₹6,000 for second child if girl (in 2 installments). Covers wage loss, nutrition needs.
application_process: 1. Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) within 150 days of last menstrual period. 2. Fill PMMVY application forms 1A, 1B, 1C at AWC. 3. Submit documents. 4. Installments credited after each antenatal visit milestone. Apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
source_name: wcd.nic.in (Ministry of Women and Child Development)

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive seasonal crop insurance providing financial support and risk coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest for farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is India's flagship crop insurance scheme. Enrolment is 100% voluntary for all farmers. For loanee farmers, coverage is applied automatically through their financing bank unless an explicit opt-out declaration is submitted in writing to the bank branch at least 7 days before the seasonal cutoff date. Non-loanee farmers apply voluntarily. Farmers pay a subsidized premium of 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops, with the remaining actuarial premium shared 50:50 between the Centre and States (90:10 in North Eastern states). Cutoff dates and notified crops are not universal fixed calendar dates; they are notified independently by each State Government per season per district.
benefits: Comprehensive risk coverage across all crop stages: prevented sowing, standing crop damage (drought, flood, pest), post-harvest losses, and localized calamities. Farmer premium capped at 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
documents: Land ownership documents / RoR (Record of Rights) / Land possession certificate
Tenancy agreement / Sowing declaration (for tenant and sharecropper farmers)
Sowing certificate / Crop details certified by Patwari/Village Revenue Officer
application_process: 1. Verify whether your crop and district are notified for the current season on pmfby.gov.in. 2. Loanee farmers are enrolled automatically by their lending bank branch unless they submit a written opt-out declaration at least 7 days prior to the state-notified cutoff date. 3. Non-loanee farmers apply online via the National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), Common Service Centres (CSCs), or bank branches before the state-notified seasonal cutoff date.
source_name: pmfby.gov.in (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial grant for rural houseless households and families living in 0, 1, or 2 room kutcha houses with basic amenities, identified through SECC and Awaas+ surveys verified by the Gram Sabha.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) provides non-refundable financial assistance to rural houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses. Eligibility is not determined by general caste or category tags; it is determined through objective housing deprivation scores from the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC 2011) and Awaas+ surveys verified by the local Gram Sabha. Households meeting any of the 10 automatic exclusion criteria (such as owning a motorized 3/4 wheeler, mechanized farm equipment, government employment, any family member earning over ₹15,000/month, income/professional tax payment, or land exceeding 2.5 acres irrigated / 5 acres unirrigated) are strictly disqualified.
benefits: Direct grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/Himalayan states and UTs transferred via DBT in installments linked to physical construction progress (foundation, lintel, roof). Entitled to 90–95 person-days of unskilled labor wages under rural employment schemes and ₹12,000 for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin.
documents: Bank account details (linked with Aadhaar for DBT)
PMAY-G / Awaas+ registration ID or SECC household ID
Land / site ownership document or Gram Panchayat allotment certificate
Affidavit affirming non-ownership of any pucca house in India
application_process: 1. PMAY-G does not have an open public online signup form. Beneficiary lists are formulated through village Awaas+ administrative surveys verified and prioritized by the Gram Sabha. 2. Rural citizens can verify their name, registration status, and priority on the permanent waiting list via pmayg.nic.in or at their Gram Panchayat. 3. Upon administrative sanction, installments are disbursed directly via DBT after geo-tagged photographic inspection at each construction stage.
source_name: pmayg.nic.in (Ministry of Rural Development)

name: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G)
description: Statutory rural employment guarantee providing up to 125 days of wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work, in force from 1 July 2026.
detailed_description: The Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (VB-G RAM G) came into force on 1 July 2026, succeeding and repealing the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005. The Act enhances the legal entitlement of wage employment from 100 days to 125 days per financial year per rural household. The entitlement is strictly at the household level. The framework focuses on four thematic pillars: water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related assets, and extreme weather mitigation, planned through Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans (VGPPs) and monitored via biometric authentication, geo-referencing, and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits: Statutory legal entitlement to up to 125 days of unskilled manual wage employment per financial year per rural household. Wages paid at notified statutory wage rates directly to bank or post office accounts via DBT within 15 days. Entitled to statutory unemployment allowance if work is not allotted within 15 days of formal demand.
documents: Proof of rural residence (Ration card / Voter ID / Gram Panchayat domicile certificate)
Bank or Post Office account passbook (Aadhaar-seeded for DBT)
application_process: 1. Job Card application and work demand submission are offline administrative processes handled at the local Gram Panchayat (the portal serves for reporting, tracking, and MIS, not consumer web forms). 2. Submit oral or written application for a Job Card at the Gram Panchayat; issued within 15 days. 3. Registered Job Card holders submit a written demand for work. 4. Work is allocated within 15 days within a 5 km radius of the village. Real-time status and wage lists are tracked on vbgramg.dord.gov.in.
source_name: vbgramg.dord.gov.in (Ministry of Rural Development / PIB PRID=2290638)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
description: Monthly non-contributory social security pension for destitute senior citizens aged 60 and above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
detailed_description: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) is a core component of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) administered by the Ministry of Rural Development. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to elderly persons living in households officially certified as Below Poverty Line (BPL). The Central Government contributes ₹200 per month for persons aged 60 to 79 years and ₹500 per month for persons aged 80 years and above. Individual State Governments independently provide supplementary top-up pensions (typically ranging from ₹400 to over ₹2,000/month), making total monthly pension disbursements vary by state. All disbursements are made via DBT.
benefits: Direct monthly pension transferred via DBT. Central Government contribution: ₹200/month for beneficiaries aged 60–79 years; ₹500/month for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above. Total received monthly pension is higher based on independent State Government top-up allocations.
documents: Age proof (Birth certificate / Voter ID card / School leaving certificate / Aadhaar)
BPL ration card or BPL certificate issued by competent authority
application_process: 1. Obtain and submit application form at the local Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office (rural areas) or Municipal Corporation / Urban Local Body office (urban areas), or apply online via the national UMANG platform or state social welfare portals. 2. Submit form along with age, BPL certification, and Aadhaar-seeded bank account proof. 3. Upon verification and sanction by district authorities, monthly pensions are disbursed via PFMS/DBT.
source_name: nsap.nic.in (Ministry of Rural Development)

name: PM-SYM (Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan)
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme providing an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 for unorganized sector workers with monthly income up to ₹15,000.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) is a Central Sector Scheme administered by the Ministry of Labour and Employment in partnership with LIC. Designed for unorganized sector workers (street vendors, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, agricultural laborers, construction workers), beneficiaries in the age group of 18 to 40 years make monthly contributions between ₹55 and ₹200 depending on entry age, with an equal 50% matching contribution paid by the Central Government. The statutory income limit is strictly a monthly income of ₹15,000 or less (represented as an annual proxy of ₹1,80,000 in this database). Members of EPFO, ESIC, NPS, and income-tax payers are excluded.
benefits: Assured minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching 60 years of age. In case of death during receipt of pension, spouse is entitled to 50% family pension (₹1,500/month). Central Government provides an equal 50% matching monthly contribution throughout the accumulation period.
documents: Savings bank account / Jan Dhan account passbook with IFSC code
application_process: 1. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or self-enroll on the official Maan-dhan portal (maandhan.in). 2. Provide Aadhaar number and bank account details. 3. System calculates monthly contribution based on age (₹55/month at age 18 up to ₹200/month at age 40). 4. Pay initial installment in cash (at CSC) or online, sign auto-debit mandate, and receive a unique Shram Yogi Pension Card.
source_name: maandhan.in (Ministry of Labour and Employment)

name: PM-KMY (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Old-age pension scheme providing an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 to small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares (5 acres). Implemented in partnership with LIC, farmers between 18 and 40 years of age make monthly contributions between ₹55 and ₹200 depending on entry age, with an equal matching contribution by the Central Government. Farmers can opt to have contributions deducted from PM-KISAN installments. Mandatory exclusions: institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, serving/retired government employees, income-tax payers, practicing professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs), and beneficiaries of NPS, EPFO, ESIC, or PM-SYM are ineligible.
benefits: Assured minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 on attaining 60 years of age. 50% matching contribution paid by Central Government. Option for auto-debit of farmer's contribution directly from PM-KISAN DBT installments. 50% spouse family pension in the event of beneficiary's death.
documents: Land ownership documents / Khasra-Khatauni records proving cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares
PM-KISAN registration number (if opting for auto-debit from PM-KISAN)
application_process: 1. Eligible farmers can enroll online via pmkmy.gov.in / maandhan.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Provide Aadhaar, bank passbook, and land ownership records. 3. Choose contribution mode (direct bank auto-debit or PM-KISAN installment deduction). 4. Upon verification, the Kisan Pension Card with unique Pension Account Number is generated.
source_name: pmkmy.gov.in (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare)

name: NAPS-2 (National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme Phase-2)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: National scheme promoting industrial apprenticeship training through partial government stipend support of 25% (up to ₹1,500/month) directly to apprentices via DBT.
detailed_description: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme Phase-2 (NAPS-2) promotes apprenticeship training across India by providing direct financial support to apprentices and incentivizing employers. The Government of India provides partial stipend support of 25% of the prescribed minimum stipend payable to the apprentice, subject to a ceiling of ₹1,500 per month per apprentice, directly transferred to the apprentice's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The remaining stipend is paid by the employer. Candidates receive hands-on training and a recognized National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).
benefits: Monthly stipend support: Government pays 25% of prescribed stipend up to a maximum cap of ₹1,500/month directly to apprentice's bank account via DBT during training. Recognized National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by NCVET upon successful assessment.
application_process: 1. Register as a candidate on the official apprenticeship portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in). 2. Complete candidate e-KYC using Aadhaar and fill educational profile. 3. Browse apprenticeship opportunities posted by registered establishments. 4. Apply online for suitable vacancies. 5. Once selected, sign apprenticeship contract digitally on portal to initiate training and DBT stipend disbursement.
source_name: apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship)

name: PM-MKSSY (Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Central Sector sub-scheme under PMMSY providing performance grants, digital work identities on NFDP, and aquaculture insurance subsidies for fisheries workers and micro-enterprises.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY) is an independent Central Sector Sub-scheme implemented under the overarching umbrella of PMMSY for an operational duration from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27 with an outlay of ₹6,000 crore. The sub-scheme provides: (1) formal digital identities on the National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP) to facilitate credit; (2) a one-time aquaculture insurance premium incentive of 40% (up to ₹25,000/ha, max ₹1,00,000 per farmer for standard farms up to 4 ha; with an additional 10% bonus for SC, ST, and Women farmers); and (3) performance grants up to 25% (or ₹35 lakh) for general micro-enterprises and up to 35% (or ₹45 lakh) for SC/ST/Women-led entities adopting safety, quality, and supply-chain standards.
benefits: One-time aquaculture insurance premium incentive: 40% of premium cost (up to ₹25,000/ha, max ₹1,00,000 per farmer) for standard farms up to 4 ha; additional 10% incentive for SC, ST, and Women beneficiaries. Performance grants up to 25%–35% of total investment for micro-enterprises creating jobs and upgrading quality/safety standards. Formal digital identity card on NFDP facilitating institutional credit access.
documents: Digital identity registration on National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP)
Proof of land/water body ownership or lease agreement for aquaculture farm
Aquaculture insurance policy document (for insurance incentive claim)
Udyam registration / Enterprise documents (for micro-enterprise performance grants)
application_process: 1. Register as a fisher, fish farmer, vendor, or micro-enterprise on the National Fisheries Digital Platform (nfdp.dof.gov.in) to generate a unique digital identity. 2. Apply online for specific components (Aquaculture Insurance Incentive or Performance Grant) by uploading proof of farm operation or enterprise investment. 3. Applications are verified by state fisheries authorities and verified incentives are disbursed directly via DBT/PFMS.
source_name: nfdp.dof.gov.in (Department of Fisheries / PIB PRID=2003883)

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
department: Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance
description: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month to destitute persons, blind, disabled, orphan children, and patients suffering from severe illnesses in Maharashtra.
detailed_description: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana is a state-funded social welfare scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Maharashtra. It provides monthly subsistence support to destitute persons aged below 65 years who have no source of livelihood, persons with 40%+ disability, orphans, and persons suffering from major diseases (such as cancer, tuberculosis, AIDS, leprosy). The annual family income must not exceed ₹21,000 for destitute categories, with relaxations for severe disability.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month for a single beneficiary and ₹1,500 per family directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account through DBT.
documents: Income certificate issued by Tahsildar (annual family income up to ₹21,000)
Age proof (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Voter ID)
Disability certificate / Medical certificate from Civil Surgeon (if applicable)
application_process: 1. Citizen applies online through Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) under Social Justice department, or obtains physical application form from the local Tahsildar office. 2. Attach Tahsildar income certificate (up to ₹21,000/yr), 15-year Maharashtra domicile, age proof, and disability/medical certificate (if applicable). 3. Submit application to the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana Committee at the Taluka Tahsil office. 4. Committee sanctions monthly pension of ₹1,500 disbursed via DBT.
source_name: Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
description: Comprehensive cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary medical treatments across Maharashtra.
detailed_description: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY) is the flagship cashless health insurance scheme of Maharashtra, integrated with Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY). It covers families holding Yellow, Orange, and White Ration Cards, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cards, and Annapurna cards across all 36 districts of Maharashtra. The scheme provides coverage for 1,356 medical and surgical procedures across 34 identified specialized categories through network government and private empaneled hospitals.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, consultations, and post-discharge medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of patient / family members
Maharashtra Ration Card (Yellow / Orange / White / Antyodaya)
Valid photo identity card (Voter ID / Driving License / Pan Card)
Referral slip from network hospital or primary health centre (if applicable)
application_process: 1. Approach the Arogyamitra at any empaneled government or private network hospital in Maharashtra. 2. Present your valid Ration Card and Aadhaar card for biometric verification and beneficiary identification. 3. Hospital initiates cashless pre-authorization with the State Health Assurance Society. 4. Avail completely cashless medical/surgical treatment and discharge medication.
source_name: State Health Assurance Society, Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to farmer families in Maharashtra, complementing PM-KISAN.
detailed_description: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana is an agricultural financial assistance scheme introduced by the Government of Maharashtra. Under this scheme, all landowning farmer families in Maharashtra who are registered and eligible under the Central Government's PM-KISAN scheme receive an additional ₹6,000 per year from the State Government. This raises the total direct income support to ₹12,000 per year for Maharashtra farmers.
benefits: Direct annual financial benefit of ₹6,000 disbursed in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card linked with active bank account
Land ownership record (7/12 extract and 8A extract)
PM-KISAN registration number and e-KYC status
Bank passbook details with IFSC code
application_process: 1. Active eligible beneficiaries under PM-KISAN residing in Maharashtra are onboarded automatically upon land seeding and e-KYC verification. 2. Non-registered farmers can register via the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or Krishi Maharashtra portal (krishi.maharashtra.gov.in) with their 7/12 land records. 3. Verification is completed by the Taluka Agriculture Officer and funds are credited via DBT.
source_name: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra

name: Mukhyamantri Amrutam (MA / MA Vatsalya) Yojana
description: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for tertiary illnesses for low-income households in Gujarat.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Amrutam (MA) and MA Vatsalya Yojana are tertiary care health assurance schemes implemented by the Health and Family Welfare Department of Gujarat. MA covers Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, while MA Vatsalya covers families with an annual income up to ₹4,00,000. It covers severe and catastrophic conditions including cardiovascular surgeries, neurosurgery, burns, poly-trauma, cancer, renal diseases, and neonatal diseases through a network of accredited private and government hospitals.
benefits: Cashless coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, surgery, and diagnostics.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Income certificate issued by Mamlatdar / Taluka Development Officer (TDO)
application_process: 1. Visit the nearest Taluka Kiosk, Civic Centre, or District Hospital MA Kiosk. 2. Submit income certificate, ration card, and family Aadhaar details. 3. Complete biometric fingerprint and photograph capture. 4. Receive MA / MA Vatsalya Health Card for cashless hospitalization.
source_name: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat

name: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana
description: Provides reliable 3-phase daytime electricity power supply from 5 AM to 9 PM to agricultural farmers in Gujarat for farm irrigation.
detailed_description: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana is an agricultural infrastructure and power delivery initiative launched by the Government of Gujarat. To eliminate the hazard of nighttime irrigation in fields (wild animal attacks, snakebites, and cold exposure), the scheme provides 8 hours of uninterrupted 3-phase power supply to agricultural feeders during daytime hours (between 5:00 AM and 9:00 PM) by expanding 66 KV transmission networks and substation capacity across rural Gujarat.
benefits: Guaranteed daytime agricultural electricity power supply of 8 hours daily for crop irrigation, improving farmer safety and crop yield management.
documents: Agricultural electricity connection consumer number / passbook
Aadhaar card of the landholding farmer
application_process: 1. Kisan Suryodaya Yojana is an agricultural feeder infrastructure project executed by Gujarat DISCOMs (UGVCL, PGVCL, MGVCL, DGVCL). 2. Existing agricultural electricity connections are automatically transitioned to 8 hours of daytime power supply (between 5:00 AM and 9:00 PM) as transmission substations are upgraded. 3. New farmers apply for agricultural power connections through their local DISCOM sub-divisional office or online at guvnl.gujarat.gov.in.
source_name: Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL), Energy and Petrochemicals Department

name: Kunwarbai Nu Mameru Yojana
description: Financial assistance of ₹12,000 to daughters from socially backward and economically weaker families in Gujarat at the time of marriage.
detailed_description: Kunwarbai Nu Mameru Yojana is a state welfare initiative implemented by the Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare and Developing Castes Welfare, Government of Gujarat. The scheme assists poor parents from Scheduled Castes, Developing Castes (OBC/SEBC), and economically weaker sections with marriage expenses for their daughters. Eligible brides receive direct financial grant credited into their bank accounts to support wedding expenditures.
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹12,000 deposited directly into the newly wedded bride's savings bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of bride and bridegroom
Marriage registration certificate (issued by Gram Panchayat / Municipality)
Caste certificate of bride or father (SC / SEBC / Developing Castes)
Income certificate issued by competent authority (annual income up to ₹1,20,000 for rural / ₹1,50,000 for urban)
Bank passbook of the bride (Aadhaar linked)
Age proof showing bride was at least 18 years on the date of marriage
application_process: 1. Register on the e-Samaj Kalyan portal (esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in). 2. Select 'Kunwarbai Nu Mameru Yojana' under Director Scheduled Caste / Developing Castes Welfare. 3. Fill applicant details and upload marriage certificate, income proof, and bank passbook within two years of marriage. 4. Verification is conducted by District Social Welfare Officer and funds disbursed via DBT.
source_name: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (MAAY - erstwhile Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana)
department: Rajasthan State Health Assurance Agency (RSHAA), Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary inpatient hospital care across Rajasthan.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (MAAY) is the converged flagship health assurance scheme of the Government of Rajasthan (restructured from the erstwhile Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana in 2024). Converged with Ayushman Bharat (AB-MAAY), it provides comprehensive cashless inpatient medical and surgical treatments across 1,800+ recognized packages. Eligible NFSA families, SECC households, small/marginal farmers, contract workers, and Covid ex-gratia families receive 100% free state-funded coverage, while other resident families can enroll by paying a subsidized premium of ₹850/year. Jan Aadhaar card is the primary identification document.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization, surgical procedures, diagnostic tests, consultations, and post-discharge medicines up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year in empaneled hospitals.
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Enrolment Slip (mandatory for Rajasthan)
Land possession certificate / RoR (for small & marginal farmers)
application_process: 1. Visit the Chiranjeevi portal (chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in) or nearest E-Mitra kiosk. 2. Login using SSO ID and enter Jan Aadhaar number. 3. Free categories verify status automatically; other families pay ₹850 annual premium online. 4. Present Jan Aadhaar at any empaneled hospital for instant cashless admission.
source_name: Rajasthan State Health Assurance Agency (RSHAA), Government of Rajasthan

name: Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Hathleva Yojana
description: Financial assistance of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 for the marriage of adult daughters from BPL, Antyodaya, and destitute families in Rajasthan.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Kanyadan (Hathleva) Yojana is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan. It supports economically disadvantaged parents, destitute widows, and PWD parents in solemnizing their daughters' marriages. The base grant is ₹31,000, which increases to ₹41,000 if the bride has passed 10th standard, and ₹51,000 if the bride is a graduate, incentivizing female education.
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 (standard), ₹41,000 (10th pass bride), or ₹51,000 (graduate bride) transferred directly via DBT.
documents: Age proof verifying bride is 18+ and groom is 21+ at marriage
BPL Card / Antyodaya Card / Income Certificate
Educational marksheets (10th standard / Degree certificate for incentive top-up)
application_process: 1. Apply online through SSO Rajasthan portal or E-Mitra kiosk within 6 months before or after marriage. 2. Upload Jan Aadhaar, marriage certificate, age proof, and educational certificates. 3. Verification is performed by the Social Welfare Officer / Block Development Officer. 4. Approved grant is credited via DBT to the bride's bank account.
source_name: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana
department: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship
description: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹4,000 to ₹4,500 along with skill training and internship for educated unemployed youth in Rajasthan.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (formerly Rajasthan Berojgari Bhatta) provides financial assistance and skill empowerment to unemployed graduate youth residing in Rajasthan. Beneficiary male youth receive ₹4,000 per month and female/transgender/PWD youth receive ₹4,500 per month for a maximum duration of two years or until gaining employment. Beneficiaries undergo 3 months of skill training and 4 hours daily internship in government departments.
benefits: Monthly allowance of ₹4,000 (male) or ₹4,500 (female/transgender/divyang) for up to 2 years, coupled with government internship and skill certification.
documents: Jan Aadhaar card and Aadhaar card
Self-declaration of unemployment and non-enrollment in regular higher studies
Family income certificate showing annual income below ₹2,00,000
Bank passbook linked to Jan Aadhaar
application_process: 1. Register on the Rajasthan Employment Exchange portal (employment.livelihoods.rajasthan.gov.in) using SSO ID. 2. Fill the Yuva Sambal application form with educational qualifications and unemployment declaration. 3. Select department for daily 4-hour internship and undergo RSLDC skill training. 4. Monthly allowance is credited to bank account upon monthly attendance certification.
source_name: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Government of Rajasthan

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana 2.0
description: Comprehensive financial support of ₹1,43,000 from birth up to college education to ensure higher education and empowerment of girl children in MP.
detailed_description: Ladli Laxmi Yojana is Madhya Pradesh's landmark girl-child welfare scheme launched to improve the child sex ratio, eliminate female feticide, and promote education. Under Ladli Laxmi 2.0, an assurance certificate of ₹1,43,000 is issued in the name of the girl child. Periodic educational scholarships are credited upon admission to Class 6 (₹2,000), Class 9 (₹4,000), Class 11 (₹6,000), and Class 12 (₹6,000). A lumpsum incentive of ₹25,000 is provided on taking college admission, and the final maturity amount of ₹1,00,000 is paid on turning 21 years without early marriage.
benefits: Total financial benefit of ₹1,43,000: school scholarships at classes 6, 9, 11, 12, ₹25,000 for college admission, and ₹1,00,000 lump sum at age 21.
documents: Samagra ID and Family Samagra ID
Birth certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar card of parents and child
Family planning certificate (in case of second girl child)
application_process: 1. Apply online through the Ladli Laxmi portal (ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in) or through the local Anganwadi Centre within one year of child's birth. 2. Anganwadi worker and Project Officer verify birth and Samagra details. 3. Digital Ladli Laxmi Certificate is issued. 4. Scholarship and college admission installments are triggered automatically as the child passes academic milestones.
source_name: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
department: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
description: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year in three installments to farmer families in Madhya Pradesh as a top-up to PM-KISAN.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana is an agricultural income support scheme implemented by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this initiative, all small, marginal, and landowning farmers in Madhya Pradesh who are registered and eligible under the PM-KISAN scheme receive an additional ₹6,000 per year from the state government in three installments of ₹2,000 each, raising combined annual assistance to ₹12,000 per year.
benefits: Direct annual financial support of ₹6,000 transferred in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each via DBT into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
documents: Bank passbook details with IFSC code
application_process: 1. Landowning farmers registered under PM-KISAN in Madhya Pradesh are onboarded through the SAARA portal (saara.mp.gov.in). 2. Patwari conducts physical and revenue record verification of landholdings. 3. Tehsildar approves eligibility and DBT payment orders are issued directly to bank accounts.
source_name: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

name: Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana
department: Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment Department
description: Industry-oriented on-the-job vocational training with a monthly stipend of ₹8,000 to ₹10,000 for unemployed youth aged 18 to 29 in MP.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana (MMSKY) is an experiential skill development and apprenticeship initiative designed to bridge the gap between academic education and industry requirements. Youth aged 18–29 years residing in MP receive certified industrial training across manufacturing, IT, banking, hospitality, and engineering sectors. The state government contributes 75% of the stipend directly via DBT, with the balance 25% paid by the private establishment.
benefits: Monthly stipend based on qualification: ₹8,000 (12th pass), ₹8,500 (ITI), ₹9,000 (Diploma), and ₹10,000 (Graduate/Post Graduate) for 1 year training with State Skill Development Council certification.
documents: Active mobile number linked to Samagra
application_process: 1. Register as a candidate on the MMSKY portal (mmsky.mp.gov.in) using Samagra ID and complete e-KYC. 2. Browse listed industrial courses and partner establishments across MP. 3. Apply for vacancies and attend interview/selection by the enterprise. 4. Sign apprenticeship contract; monthly stipend is credited via DBT upon biometric attendance.
source_name: Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment Department, MP

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
description: Conditional cash transfer of ₹25,000 in six developmental stages from birth to graduation for girl children in Uttar Pradesh.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana is a flagship girl empowerment and education program administered by the Women and Child Development Department of Uttar Pradesh. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 across 6 stages: at birth (₹5,000), upon complete vaccination (₹2,000), admission in Class 1 (₹3,000), Class 6 (₹3,000), Class 9 (₹5,000), and admission to a Degree/Diploma course after Class 12 (₹7,000). Maximum two daughters per family are eligible.
benefits: Direct financial transfers totaling ₹25,000 across six key developmental and educational milestones transferred directly via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of girl child and parents/guardians
Uttar Pradesh domicile certificate / Ration card
Income certificate (annual family income up to ₹3,00,000)
Birth certificate and immunization card (for stage 1 and 2)
School/College admission proof (fees receipt / ID card for stages 3 to 6)
Bank passbook of girl child or joint account with mother
application_process: 1. Register on the official portal (mksy.up.gov.in). 2. Create user ID, fill girl child and family details. 3. Select the applicable stage (Stage 1 to 6) and upload required certificates. 4. Application is verified by Block Development Officer / SDM and funds are transferred via PFMS/DBT.
source_name: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana
description: Free high-quality coaching, guidance, study materials, and tablet assistance for competitive exam aspirants from low-income families in UP.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana provides free competitive examination coaching for youth from economically weaker and underprivileged sections of Uttar Pradesh. The scheme offers physical and virtual coaching centers in all 75 districts for exams including UPSC Civil Services, UPPSC, JEE Mains/Advanced, NEET, NDA, CDS, and paramilitary forces. Coaching is delivered by senior IAS/IPS/PCS officers and expert educators, supplemented by an online question bank and digital library.
benefits: Free offline and online classroom coaching, mentorship from civil servants, access to digital e-learning content, and free tablets for selected meritorious students.
application_process: 1. Visit the Abhyudaya portal (abhyuday.up.gov.in). 2. Register with mobile number and select target competitive exam (UPSC/UPPSC/JEE/NEET/NDA). 3. Appear for the state-level eligibility/screening test conducted annually. 4. Qualified candidates are allotted coaching batches at the district level or online portal access.
source_name: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

name: UP Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana
description: Financial grant of ₹51,000 per couple for mass marriages of daughters from BPL and economically weaker families in Uttar Pradesh.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana is executed by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, to eliminate dowry, child marriage, and exorbitant wedding debts among poor families. Community marriages are organized by urban local bodies and district administrations. For every eligible couple, ₹51,000 is sanctioned: ₹35,000 credited directly to the bride's bank account, ₹10,000 provided as wedding gift articles (clothes, silver ornaments, utensils), and ₹6,000 utilized for wedding ceremony organization.
benefits: Total support of ₹51,000: ₹35,000 direct bank transfer to bride, ₹10,000 worth of household and bridal articles, and ₹6,000 event expenses.
documents: Aadhaar card of bride and groom
Income certificate (annual family income up to ₹2,00,000)
Caste certificate (if applying under SC/ST/OBC category)
application_process: 1. Apply online via the portal (samuhikvivah.upsdc.gov.in) or visit the Block Development Office / Municipal Corporation. 2. Submit application with age, income, and domicile proofs. 3. Physical verification is completed by the Assistant Development Officer (Social Welfare). 4. Ceremony is organized and financial assistance credited to the bride's account.
source_name: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
department: Education Department and Social Welfare Department
description: Financial incentives up to ₹54,100 from birth to university graduation for girl students in Bihar to prevent child marriage and foster higher education.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is a comprehensive girl empowerment initiative implemented by the Government of Bihar. It supports girl children through various educational stages: birth grant of ₹2,000, Aadhaar registration grant of ₹1,000, completion of immunization (₹2,000), sanitary napkin and uniform allowances, ₹25,000 incentive upon passing Intermediate (Class 12) unmarried, and ₹50,000 upon graduation from any recognized university in Bihar.
benefits: Direct cash assistance: ₹25,000 on passing Class 12 (unmarried) and ₹50,000 on graduation from a recognized college, plus school uniform and nutrition stipends.
documents: Aadhaar card of the female student
Class 12 / Graduation final marksheet and admit card
Bank passbook in student's name (Aadhaar linked)
application_process: 1. Visit the Medhasoft / e-Kalyan Bihar portal (medhasoft.bih.nic.in). 2. Select Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (10+2 or Graduation). 3. Enter university registration number, roll number, and Aadhaar details. 4. Institution verifies academic records and state disburses grant directly via DBT.
source_name: Education Department, Government of Bihar

name: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana
description: Financial project assistance up to ₹10,00,000 (50% grant up to ₹5 lakh + 50% interest-free loan) to set up micro and small manufacturing units in Bihar.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (encompassing SC/ST, EBC, Mahila, and Yuva Udyami variants) is Bihar's flagship entrepreneurship program. It encourages youth and women to establish new micro industrial and manufacturing enterprises. Beneficiaries receive project assistance up to ₹10,00,000: 50% (up to ₹5,00,000) is a non-refundable capital subsidy/grant, and the remaining 50% is an interest-free loan (or 1% simple interest for general youth) repayable in 84 monthly installments after a 1-year moratorium.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹10,00,000 per project: ₹5,00,000 grant/subsidy and ₹5,00,000 soft loan, plus ₹25,000 for training and project report preparation.
documents: 10+2 / Intermediate / ITI / Polytechnic Diploma / Degree certificate
Current bank account statement in the name of the firm/applicant
application_process: 1. Apply online on the Udyami portal (udyami.bihar.gov.in) during the annual registration window. 2. Select preferred project sector from the approved list of manufacturing/service activities. 3. Computerized random lottery selects shortlisted applicants. 4. Shortlisted candidates attend 2 weeks of entrepreneurship training and receive phased disbursements.
source_name: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
description: Concessional education loan up to ₹4,00,000 for students who have passed Class 12 in Bihar to pursue general and professional higher education.
detailed_description: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCCS) is a key initiative under the state's 'Saat Nischay' vision. It enables students from economically weaker backgrounds to pursue technical, professional, and general degree courses without financial roadblocks. The state government acts as the loan guarantor for bank loans up to ₹4,00,000. Interest rates are heavily subsidized: 1% for female, transgender, and disabled students, and 4% for male students. Repayment begins 1 year after course completion or upon securing employment.
benefits: Education loan up to ₹4,00,000 covering tuition fees, books, laptops, and hostel accommodation with government guarantee and subsidized interest.
documents: Aadhaar card of student and co-applicant (parent)
Class 10th and 12th marksheet and passing certificates
Admission letter and fee schedule from recognized college/institution
PAN card of student and parent
application_process: 1. Register on the MNSSBY portal (7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in). 2. Submit student and institutional details and download the confirmation slip. 3. Visit the District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC) with original documents for verification. 4. Bihar State Education Finance Corporation sanctions loan and disburses fees directly to college.
source_name: Bihar State Higher Education Council, Education Department, Government of Bihar

name: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana
department: Women, Child Development and Social Security Department
description: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 per year) to women aged 18 to 50 years residing in Jharkhand.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana (JMMSY) is a state welfare initiative implemented by the Women, Child Development and Social Security Department of Jharkhand. It provides basic income security to adult women between 18 and 50 years from low-income, Antyodaya, and priority households. Benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account on a monthly basis.
benefits: Monthly cash transfer of ₹1,000 credited directly into the woman beneficiary's bank account via DBT to ensure nutritional and personal security.
documents: Jharkhand Ration Card (Antyodaya / Pink / White / Green card)
Aadhaar-linked bank account passbook with IFSC code
Self-declaration of not receiving any other social pension or paying income tax
application_process: 1. Collect application form from Gram Panchayat camp or Anganwadi Centre or download from mmmsy.jharkhand.gov.in. 2. Submit filled form with Aadhaar and ration card copy at the special camps or CSC kiosk. 3. Block Development Officer / Child Development Project Officer verifies beneficiary. 4. DBT payments are triggered monthly.
source_name: Women, Child Development and Social Security Department, Government of Jharkhand

name: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship
department: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare Department
description: Full scholarship covering 100% tuition, living expenses, and airfare for students from Jharkhand pursuing Master's/M.Phil in top UK universities.
detailed_description: The Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme is a visionary educational initiative of the Government of Jharkhand. It finances up to 25 eligible students annually from Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, and Other Backward Classes to pursue Master's and research degrees in prestigious universities across the United Kingdom and Northern Ireland (such as Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, Imperial). The state covers 100% of tuition fees, travel expenses, visa fees, health insurance, and annual maintenance allowance.
benefits: 100% tuition fee coverage, living stipend/maintenance allowance, overseas health surcharge, visa charges, and return economy airfare.
documents: Caste certificate (ST/SC/OBC/Minority) issued by competent authority
Graduation degree certificate with minimum 55% marks
Offer letter / Admission confirmation from recognized UK university
application_process: 1. Apply online at the official portal (mgjmos.jharkhand.gov.in) upon securing an offer from an empaneled university. 2. Upload academic transcripts, university offer letter, and income/caste certificates. 3. State Steering Committee shortlists applicants and conducts interviews. 4. Sanction order is issued and funds remitted directly to the university and scholar.
source_name: ST, SC, Minority and BC Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand

name: Abua Awas Yojana
description: Financial grant of ₹2,00,000 in four installments to build a permanent three-room pucca house with a kitchen for homeless rural families in Jharkhand.
detailed_description: Abua Awas Yojana (AAY) is a state-funded rural housing scheme launched by the Government of Jharkhand to provide durable pucca houses to rural families left out of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G). The scheme grants ₹2,00,000 to construct a 31 sq. metre three-room house with a dedicated kitchen. In addition, beneficiaries receive 90–95 person-days of unskilled wages under rural employment schemes and convergence assistance for toilet construction.
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 in four construction-linked installments (Foundation: ₹30k, Lintel: ₹50k, Roof: ₹1 lakh, Finishing: ₹20k) plus wage support.
documents: Aadhaar card of head of household and family members
Ration Card / Proof of rural residence
Certificate of kutcha house / homeless status from Gram Sabha
Self-declaration of not owning any pucca house
application_process: 1. Applications are collected at 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camps or submitted to the Gram Panchayat. 2. Gram Sabha conducts physical verification and approves beneficiary priority lists. 3. Geo-tagged photographs of construction stages are uploaded via mobile app. 4. Installments are disbursed directly into bank accounts via DBT.
source_name: Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand

name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 (₹12,000 annually) to married women aged 21 and above residing in Chhattisgarh.
detailed_description: Mahtari Vandan Yojana is a key social protection scheme executed by the Women and Child Development Department of Chhattisgarh. It provides direct basic income support of ₹1,000 per month to married, widowed, divorced, and abandoned women aged 21 and above who are permanent residents of Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to enhance female nutritional health, economic autonomy, and family well-being through direct bank transfers.
benefits: Monthly cash assistance of ₹1,000 deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked savings bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of applicant and husband
Marriage certificate / Proof of marriage (or widow/divorce proof)
Self-declaration of family income and non-income-tax status
application_process: 1. Apply online via the Mahtari Vandan portal (mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in) or submit form at Gram Panchayat / Anganwadi Centre. 2. Enter Aadhaar and bank details for e-KYC verification. 3. Anganwadi worker and Supervisor verify field records. 4. Approved list receives monthly DBT on the designated date.
source_name: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Chhattisgarh

name: Krishak Unnati Yojana
department: Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare Department
description: Input assistance ensuring paddy farmers in Chhattisgarh receive ₹3,100 per quintal for up to 21 quintals per acre of paddy sold.
detailed_description: Krishak Unnati Yojana is Chhattisgarh's agricultural income enhancement scheme. It guarantees farmers selling paddy at primary agricultural credit societies (PACS) a total payout of ₹3,100 per quintal for up to 21 quintals per acre. The differential amount between the central Minimum Support Price (MSP) and the state benchmark price of ₹3,100 is disbursed directly into the farmers' bank accounts via DBT as input assistance.
benefits: Guaranteed remunerative return of ₹3,100 per quintal of paddy on yields up to 21 quintals/acre, with the difference credited via DBT.
documents: Unified Farmer Portal (Kisan Portal) registration number
Land revenue record (B-1 / P-II Khasra copy)
application_process: 1. Register on the Chhattisgarh Kisan Portal (kisan.cg.nic.in) before procurement season. 2. Revenue department verifies land records and cultivable paddy acreage. 3. Generate electronic token and sell paddy at the local procurement mandi/PACS. 4. Difference payment is credited via DBT to the farmer's bank account.
source_name: Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare Department, Chhattisgarh

name: Shri Dhanwantri Generic Medical Store Scheme
description: Provides high-quality generic medicines, surgical consumables, and herbal items at 50% to 71% discount on MRP across urban centers in Chhattisgarh.
detailed_description: Shri Dhanwantri Generic Medical Store Scheme is a healthcare accessibility and financial relief scheme administered by the Urban Administration and Development Department of Chhattisgarh. It operates dedicated generic medical stores across all urban local bodies, providing certified quality generic medicines, surgical goods, sanitisers, and Ayurvedic products manufactured by reputed pharmaceutical companies at steep discounts ranging from 50% to 71% off Maximum Retail Price (MRP).
benefits: Heavy discount of 50% to 71% on retail prices of essential prescription medicines, chronic disease drugs (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac care), and surgical items.
documents: Valid medical prescription from a registered medical practitioner (for prescription drugs)
Any photo ID card (optional/general retail purchase)
application_process: 1. Retail pharmacy service scheme; no online citizen application required. 2. Visit any Shri Dhanwantri Generic Medical Store established in municipal corporations, municipalities, and Nagar Panchayats across Chhattisgarh. 3. Present a valid prescription from a registered medical practitioner. 4. Purchase quality certified generic medicines, surgical goods, and herbal products at 50% to 71% discount on Maximum Retail Price (MRP).
source_name: Urban Administration and Development Department, Government of Chhattisgarh

name: Griha Aadhar Scheme
department: Directorate of Women and Child Development
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 to homemakers and housewives in Goa from families with annual income up to ₹3,00,000.
detailed_description: Griha Aadhar Scheme is a social security initiative implemented by the Directorate of Women and Child Development, Government of Goa. It aims to disburse financial support directly to housewives and homemakers to help them maintain household budgets and cushion the impact of inflation. Eligible married women receiving this assistance can utilize funds for household groceries, children's nutrition, and education.
benefits: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,500 deposited directly into the homemaker's bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of applicant and husband
Income certificate issued by competent authority (annual income under ₹3,00,000)
application_process: 1. Download official application form from dwcd.goa.gov.in or collect from Directorate of Women and Child Development, Panaji. 2. Attach 15-year Goa residence certificate, income certificate (under ₹3,00,000/yr), marriage certificate, and bank passbook. 3. Submit application in-person through the local Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) or Village Panchayat. 4. Upon verification, monthly assistance of ₹1,500 is disbursed directly via DBT.
source_name: Directorate of Women and Child Development, Government of Goa

name: Dayanand Social Security Scheme
description: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 to ₹3,500 for senior citizens, widows, disabled persons, and single women in Goa.
detailed_description: Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS) is a comprehensive state pension scheme executed by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa. It provides vital financial subsistence to vulnerable segments of Goan society including senior citizens aged 60+, destitute widows, persons with severe disabilities, and single women lacking adequate family support. Monthly pensions range from ₹2,000 for standard beneficiaries up to ₹3,500 for persons with severe permanent disabilities.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 to ₹3,500 transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through DBT.
documents: Age proof (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate)
Family income certificate (annual income up to ₹1,50,000)
Disability certificate / Death certificate of spouse (if applicable)
application_process: 1. Obtain application form from the Directorate of Social Welfare, Panaji, or download from socialwelfare.goa.gov.in. 2. Attach 15-year Goa domicile certificate, age proof (60+), family income certificate (up to ₹1,50,000/yr), and disability/widowhood proof (if applicable). 3. Submit application at the Taluka Social Welfare Office. 4. Sanctioned pension of ₹2,000 to ₹3,500/month is credited directly into bank accounts via DBT.
source_name: Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
description: Direct monthly cash benefit of ₹2,000 to the woman head of household in Antyodaya, BPL, and APL families in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Gruha Lakshmi is one of the flagship guarantee welfare schemes of the Government of Karnataka, executed by the Department of Women and Child Development. Under the scheme, the recognized female head of eligible households receives ₹2,000 per month deposited directly into her Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Women heads whose families hold Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards are eligible, provided they or their spouses do not pay income tax or GST.
benefits: Direct monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 credited directly into the woman head of household's bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman head and her husband
Karnataka Ration Card (Antyodaya / BPL / APL) identifying the woman as head of family
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
