application_process: 1. Register online via Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in) or visit Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centres. 2. Provide Ration Card number and complete Aadhaar biometric e-KYC. 3. Upon verification against tax databases, monthly DBT is scheduled directly to the bank account.
source_name: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
description: Monthly unemployment financial aid of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders unemployed for 6 months in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Yuva Nidhi Scheme is a state unemployment assistance and skill-building initiative of the Government of Karnataka. It assists educated youth who passed their degree or diploma from recognized Karnataka universities/institutions and remain unemployed after 6 months of graduation. Degree holders receive ₹3,000/month and diploma holders receive ₹1,500/month for up to 2 years or until employment, coupled with mandatory skill enhancement courses.
benefits: Monthly allowance of ₹3,000 (Degree graduates) or ₹1,500 (Diploma holders) for up to 24 months, with free vocational training through the Karnataka Skill Mission.
documents: Degree / Diploma marks cards and convocation certificate
Karnataka Domicile / Study Certificate proving 6+ years education in Karnataka
Self-declaration of unemployment and non-higher education enrollment
application_process: 1. Visit the Seva Sindhu Yuva Nidhi portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in). 2. Enter Aadhaar number and college roll/registration number for university record fetching. 3. Submit monthly unemployment declaration. 4. Allowance is credited via DBT directly into the bank account.
source_name: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Karnataka

name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme
description: Free domestic electricity consumption up to 200 units per month for all residential households across Karnataka.
detailed_description: Gruha Jyothi is a universal domestic power subsidy scheme launched by the Government of Karnataka. Every residential household in Karnataka is entitled to free domestic power up to a cap of 200 units per month based on their average monthly consumption plus a 10% buffer. Households whose consumption falls within their calculated entitlement receive a zero-rupee electricity bill.
benefits: 100% subsidy (zero electricity bill) on domestic power consumption up to 200 units per month per household.
documents: Electricity Consumer Account ID (Account ID on electricity bill from BESCOM, MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, or CHESCOM)
Tenancy agreement / Rental agreement (for tenants) or property tax receipt (for owners)
application_process: 1. Apply online via Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in) or at ESCOM sub-divisional offices / citizen service centers. 2. Select ESCOM company, enter Account ID, and link Aadhaar. 3. Subsidy is automatically deducted from monthly electricity billing cycles.
source_name: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka

name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP)
description: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization in empaneled hospitals across Kerala.
detailed_description: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) is Kerala's flagship health assurance scheme administered by the State Health Agency (SHA), converging PM-JAY and state health assistance. It covers poor and vulnerable families across Kerala, providing cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for major illnesses, cancer care, kidney dialysis, cardiovascular procedures, and neurological treatments in empaneled public and private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization, diagnostic investigations, surgeries, and medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Kerala Ration Card (Pink / Yellow / Blue card)
KASP Health Card / PM-JAY Card (if generated)
application_process: 1. Visit the KASP kiosk at any empaneled government or private hospital in Kerala. 2. Present your Ration Card and Aadhaar card for beneficiary verification by the Arogyamitra. 3. Pre-authorization is processed electronically and completely cashless inpatient care is provided.
source_name: State Health Agency (SHA), Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Kerala

name: Subhiksha Keralam
department: Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare Department
description: Integrated food security and farming initiative promoting fallow-land cultivation, dairy, fisheries, and agro-subsidies in Kerala.
detailed_description: Subhiksha Keralam is an integrated mission launched by the Government of Kerala to achieve food self-sufficiency by bringing uncultivated fallow lands under cultivation. The scheme converges agriculture, animal husbandry, dairy, and fisheries departments to provide financial subsidies, seed inputs, mechanization support, and interest subvention for farmers, youth cooperatives, and Kudumbashree Joint Liability Groups (JLGs).
benefits: Subsidies up to ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per hectare for fallow-land paddy and vegetable farming, subsidized seedlings, drip irrigation grants, and interest subventions on farm credit.
documents: Aadhaar card of the farmer / JLG representative
Land possession certificate / Lease agreement for fallow land
Bank passbook details with IFSC code
application_process: 1. Register on the Agriculture Information Management System portal (aims.kerala.gov.in). 2. Submit details of cultivable land and proposed crop scheme to the local Krishi Bhavan. 3. Agricultural Officer inspects field and approves input subsidy and DBT support.
source_name: Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare Department, Government of Kerala

name: Kudumbashree Micro-Enterprise Development and Interest Subvention
description: Subsidized bank loans with interest subvention down to 4% and capital grants for women entrepreneurs in Kerala through Kudumbashree NHGs.
detailed_description: Kudumbashree is the State Poverty Eradication Mission of the Government of Kerala. Under its micro-enterprise development initiative, women members organized in Neighborhood Groups (NHGs) and Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) receive entrepreneurship training, technology tie-ups, marketing support, and subsidized bank credit. The scheme provides interest subvention that effectively reduces the bank loan interest rate to 4%, along with matching start-up capital subsidies for group ventures.
benefits: Interest subvention reducing effective loan interest to 4%, revolving funds, seed capital subsidies up to ₹1,00,000 for group micro-enterprises, and branding support.
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman applicant
Project profile / Business plan for micro-enterprise
Bank account details of the enterprise / group
Residential proof in the respective Local Self Government institution
application_process: 1. Eligible women form or join a Kudumbashree Neighborhood Group (NHG) / Joint Liability Group (JLG). 2. Prepare a micro-enterprise business plan with guidance from Kudumbashree Micro-Enterprise Consultants (MEC). 3. Submit proposal to the local Community Development Society (CDS) office. 4. CDS forwards bank loan application with interest subvention recommendation, reducing net borrowing interest to 4%.
source_name: State Poverty Eradication Mission (Kudumbashree), Local Self Government Department, Kerala

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
description: Monthly basic income grant of ₹1,000 directly transferred via DBT to eligible women heads of families in Tamil Nadu.
detailed_description: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT) is a historic basic income and women recognition program implemented by the Government of Tamil Nadu. It recognizes the unpaid domestic labor and caregiving of women by providing an unconditional rights-based basic income of ₹1,000 per month. Women heads of families holding smart ration cards with annual family income below ₹2,50,000, landholding under 5 acres wetland / 10 acres dryland, and domestic power consumption below 3,600 units/year are eligible.
benefits: Monthly cash grant of ₹1,000 credited directly into the woman head of household's bank account via DBT on the 15th of every month.
documents: Aadhaar card of the female head of family
Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card (Family Card)
application_process: 1. Apply during the special enrollment camps organized at fair price shops or via e-Sevai centres. 2. Provide Smart Ration Card and Aadhaar details for biometric verification. 3. Revenue department verifies land records and electricity data digitally. 4. Approved beneficiaries receive monthly SMS alerts and ₹1,000 DBT.
source_name: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 for female students from government schools in Tamil Nadu pursuing higher education.
detailed_description: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme) provides monthly financial support of ₹1,000 to girl students who studied in Government schools from Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu and enrolled in undergraduate degrees, professional courses, diploma programs, or ITI courses. The assistance is provided throughout the regular duration of the college degree to prevent dropouts and promote female higher education.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹1,000 transferred directly into the student's bank account every month until completion of undergraduate degree or diploma.
documents: Aadhaar card of the female student
Class 6 to 12 Government School Study Certificates (EMIS number)
College admission letter / Student ID card
Active bank account details in student's name
application_process: 1. Apply through the college nodal officer on the official portal (pudhumaipenn.tn.gov.in). 2. College verifies the student's EMIS number proving Class 6 to 12 government school education. 3. Social Welfare Department sanctions enrollment and disburses ₹1,000 via DBT monthly.
source_name: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary medical treatments in Tamil Nadu.
detailed_description: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) is implemented by the Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project in convergence with Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY). It covers families holding eligible smart ration cards with annual family income up to ₹1,20,000. The scheme provides cashless coverage for 1,513 medical and surgical procedures across private and government hospitals, including specialized pediatric surgeries, diagnostic procedures, and organ transplantations.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, and post-operative medications up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card (Family Card)
Income certificate issued by Revenue Department (annual income up to ₹1,20,000)
application_process: 1. Approach the CMCHIS kiosk at any District Collectorate or empaneled government/private hospital. 2. Submit Smart Ration Card, income certificate, and Aadhaar card for biometric enrollment. 3. Receive CMCHIS URN card. 4. Present card at empaneled hospitals for instant cashless medical services.
source_name: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

name: Annadata Sukhibhava (Andhra Pradesh - erstwhile YSR Rythu Bharosa)
description: Annual financial input assistance of ₹20,000 per farmer family (including ₹6,000 PM-KISAN) for crop cultivation in Andhra Pradesh.
detailed_description: Annadata Sukhibhava is the flagship agricultural income enhancement initiative implemented by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh (transitioned from the erstwhile YSR Rythu Bharosa in June 2024). It provides total annual financial assistance of ₹20,000 per eligible landowning farmer family and eligible tenant farmer family (comprising ₹14,000 state grant and ₹6,000 PM-KISAN component) disbursed in seasonal installments to cover seed, fertilizer, and farm operational expenses.
benefits: Total annual financial assistance of ₹20,000 per eligible farmer family (₹14,000 state contribution + ₹6,000 central PM-KISAN) disbursed directly via DBT.
documents: Pattadar Passbook / Webland land records / CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Card for tenant farmers)
application_process: 1. Check eligibility on the Rythu Bharosa portal (ysrrythubharosa.ap.gov.in) or visit the local Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK). 2. Village Agriculture Assistant conducts e-crop booking and field verification. 3. Social audit list is published at the RBK. 4. Approved funds are disbursed directly via DBT into bank accounts.
source_name: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh

name: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (Aarogyasri - Andhra Pradesh)
department: Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department
description: Cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare coverage up to ₹25,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical procedures in Andhra Pradesh.
detailed_description: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (administered by the Dr. NTR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Government of Andhra Pradesh) provides universal cashless health protection to BPL and low-income families holding Rice Cards or with annual family income up to ₹5,00,000. It covers 3,257 recognized secondary and tertiary medical/surgical procedures up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year across network public and private hospitals, including oncology, cardiovascular, pediatric surgeries, and post-operative allowances.
benefits: Completely cashless inpatient hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, and post-discharge medicines up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Andhra Pradesh White Ration Card / Rice Card
Income certificate (for non-ration card families earning under ₹5,00,000)
application_process: 1. Approach the Aarogyamitra helpdesk at any empaneled hospital in Andhra Pradesh. 2. Provide your White Ration Card or Aadhaar number for electronic verification. 3. Hospital requests online pre-authorization from the trust. 4. Receive complete cashless treatment and prescribed follow-up medicines upon discharge.
source_name: Dr. NTR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Government of Andhra Pradesh

name: Thalliki Vandanam (Andhra Pradesh - erstwhile Amma Vodi)
description: Annual financial grant of ₹15,000 per school-going child to eligible mothers who enroll their children in recognized schools (Class 1 to 12) in AP.
detailed_description: Thalliki Vandanam is an educational empowerment initiative launched by the Government of Andhra Pradesh (succeeding the erstwhile Jagananna Amma Vodi). It provides annual financial assistance of ₹15,000 per school-going child directly to mothers or recognized female guardians from low-income households who enroll and maintain regular school attendance for their children in Class 1 to 12 in recognized government, aided, or private schools.
benefits: Direct annual financial incentive of ₹15,000 per school-going child deposited into the mother's Aadhaar-linked savings bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of student and mother
White Ration Card / Rice Card of Andhra Pradesh
School admission certificate and student attendance report (minimum 75%)
application_process: 1. School headmasters verify enrolled student details and attendance on the Child Info portal. 2. Village/Ward Secretariats publish preliminary beneficiary lists for social audit. 3. Welfare and Education Assistant verifies bank accounts and e-KYC. 4. Annual DBT of ₹15,000 is credited directly into the mother's account.
source_name: Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh

name: Rythu Bharosa (Telangana - erstwhile Rythu Bandhu)
description: Direct investment support of up to ₹15,000 per acre per year directly into bank accounts of farmers and tenant cultivators in Telangana.
detailed_description: Rythu Bharosa is the enhanced agricultural investment support program of the Government of Telangana (restructured under the state's welfare guarantees from the erstwhile Rythu Bandhu scheme). It provides direct per-acre financial support to landowning farmers and verified tenant cultivators to purchase certified seeds, fertilizers, and agricultural inputs before Kharif and Rabi sowing seasons. The assistance is calibrated at ₹15,000 per acre per year (₹7,500/acre/season) credited directly into bank accounts via DBT.
benefits: Direct financial assistance of up to ₹15,000 per acre per year (₹7,500 per acre per season) transferred directly to farmers' bank accounts via DBT.
documents: Pattadar Passbook / Dharani portal land record details
application_process: 1. Farmers with updated land titles on the Dharani portal (dharani.telangana.gov.in) are identified automatically. 2. Agriculture Extension Officers (AEOs) verify bank account linking and active cultivation. 3. State government triggers seasonal DBT disbursements directly to farmers' bank accounts.
source_name: Agriculture and Cooperation Department, Government of Telangana

name: Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak Scheme
department: Scheduled Castes, BC and Minority Welfare Departments
description: One-time financial grant of ₹1,00,116 to unmarried brides aged 18+ from SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority families in Telangana at marriage.
detailed_description: Kalyana Lakshmi (and Shaadi Mubarak for Minorities) is a social welfare initiative implemented by the Government of Telangana to eradicate child marriages and assist low-income parents with wedding expenses. An assistance amount of ₹1,00,116 is transferred directly via DBT into the bride's mother's bank account. Eligible families must belong to SC, ST, BC, EBC, or Minority communities with an annual family income under ₹2,00,000 in urban areas and ₹1,50,000 in rural areas.
benefits: One-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 transferred directly to the bride's mother's bank account via DBT prior to or at the time of wedding.
documents: Aadhaar card of bride, bridegroom, and mother
Age proof certificate confirming bride is 18+ and groom is 21+
Marriage invitation card / Marriage registration certificate
Bank passbook of the bride's mother
application_process: 1. Apply online via Telangana ePass portal (telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in). 2. Upload wedding card, age proofs, income, and caste certificates. 3. Revenue Inspector / Tahsildar conducts physical verification. 4. Approved grant is credited via DBT to the bride's mother's bank account.
source_name: Scheduled Castes, BC and Minority Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri Telangana
department: Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across Telangana.
detailed_description: Rajiv Aarogyasri is the flagship state health coverage scheme of the Government of Telangana, administered by the Aarogyasri Health Care Trust. It provides comprehensive cashless medical and surgical care up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year for BPL families holding Food Security Cards. The scheme covers 1,672 treatments, diagnostic investigations, surgeries, ICU care, and post-discharge medicines through an extensive network of empaneled private and government hospitals.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, consultations, and medicines up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
application_process: 1. Visit the Aarogyamitra help desk at any empaneled government or private hospital in Telangana. 2. Present your Food Security Card and Aadhaar card for beneficiary validation. 3. Hospital raises digital pre-authorization request with the Aarogyasri Trust. 4. Avail completely cashless treatment and medications.
source_name: Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Government of Telangana

name: KALIA Scheme (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment
description: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year for small/marginal farmers and ₹12,500 for landless agricultural households in Odisha.
detailed_description: KALIA is Odisha's flagship agricultural support and rural livelihood initiative. It covers small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural laborers across Odisha. Cultivator families receive ₹10,000 per year in two installments for procurement of farm inputs. Landless agricultural households receive ₹12,500 in three installments for goat rearing, duckery, poultry, and mushroom cultivation, alongside life and disability insurance coverage.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹10,000 per year for small/marginal farmers (₹5,000 per Kharif/Rabi season) and ₹12,500 one-time livelihood assistance for landless households via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of the farmer / laborer
Bank passbook details with Aadhaar seeding
Land record copy (RoR) or self-declaration of landless status
application_process: 1. Verify inclusion on the KALIA portal (kalia.odisha.gov.in) using Aadhaar number. 2. New farmers can submit green forms at the local Gram Panchayat during special camps. 3. Gram Panchayat scrutiny and committee approval process the list. 4. Benefits are transferred directly into the beneficiary's bank account via DBT.
source_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha

name: Gopabandhu Jan Arogya Yojana (GJAY - erstwhile Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana)
description: Cashless healthcare coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year (and up to ₹10,00,000 for female family members) in empaneled hospitals across Odisha.
detailed_description: Gopabandhu Jan Arogya Yojana (GJAY) was launched by the Government of Odisha in June 2024, succeeding and replacing the erstwhile Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY). Administered by the State Health Assurance Society (SHAS), it provides completely free treatment in all state government medical college and district hospitals for all citizens. In addition, families holding NFSA or SFSS ration cards receive cashless secondary and tertiary hospital treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year (and up to ₹10,00,000 for women members) in over 700 empaneled private and premier hospitals nationwide.
benefits: Free medical treatment in state government hospitals, plus cashless inpatient treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year (and ₹10,00,000 for female family members) in empaneled private hospitals.
documents: BSKY Smart Health Card / NFSA Ration Card / SFSS Card
Referral slip from government hospital (where required)
application_process: 1. Existing NFSA and SFSS ration card holders in Odisha are covered automatically with BSKY Smart Health Cards. 2. Present card and Aadhaar at the Swasthya Mitra helpdesk at any empaneled hospital. 3. Immediate electronic verification and pre-authorization are initiated. 4. Cashless surgery and medical treatment are provided without any out-of-pocket expenditure.
source_name: State Health Assurance Society (SHAS), Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha

name: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana (MBPY)
department: Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department
description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,400 for destitute elderly, widows, persons with disabilities, and transgender persons in Odisha.
detailed_description: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana (MBPY) is Odisha's flagship social assistance pension scheme implemented by the SSEPD Department. It merges the erstwhile Revised Old Age Pension and Disability Pension schemes. It provides monthly pensions to destitute individuals aged 60+, widows, leprosy patients with deformities, persons with 40%+ disability, HIV/AIDS patients, and transgender persons whose annual family income does not exceed ₹24,000.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (age 60 to 79) and ₹1,200 to ₹1,400 (age 80+ or severe disability) disbursed on the 15th of every month directly to beneficiaries via DBT or cash at Gram Panchayat.
documents: Age proof certificate (Voter ID / School Certificate)
Income certificate issued by Revenue Officer (annual income up to ₹24,000)
Disability certificate / Death certificate of husband (if applicable)
application_process: 1. Apply online through the SSEPD portal (ssepd.odisha.gov.in) or submit green form at the Block Development Office / Urban Local Body. 2. Block Social Security Officer (BSSO) conducts field enquiry. 3. Sub-Collector approves pension sanction. 4. Monthly pension is paid via DBT on Pension Day (15th of each month).
source_name: Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Odisha

name: Krishak Bandhu (Natun)
description: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per year and ₹2,00,000 life insurance coverage for farmers and sharecroppers in West Bengal.
detailed_description: Krishak Bandhu (Natun) is the flagship agricultural security scheme of the Government of West Bengal. It offers two major components: (1) Assured financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year (₹5,000 per acre per season, with a minimum guaranteed payment of ₹4,000/year even for minimal landholders) for Kharif and Rabi agricultural inputs, and (2) Death benefit of ₹2,00,000 to the nominee of any registered farmer/bargadar aged 18 to 60 years who passes away due to natural or accidental causes.
benefits: Annual grant of ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 per year in two installments via DBT, plus ₹2,00,000 life insurance death benefit covering all natural and accidental deaths.
documents: Aadhaar card and Voter ID card (EPIC)
RoR (Record of Rights / Khatian) of cultivable land or recorded Bargadar certificate
Aadhaar-linked bank account passbook with IFSC code
application_process: 1. Apply at the local Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office or during 'Duare Sarkar' camps. 2. Submit Krishak Bandhu application form with land records and EPIC card. 3. ADA office verifies landholding and issues unique Krishak Bandhu Identification Number (KB ID). 4. Financial aid is disbursed directly into bank accounts before each crop season.
source_name: Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
department: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare
description: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 and one-time grant of ₹25,000 for teenage girls in West Bengal to prevent child marriage and promote schooling.
detailed_description: Kanyashree Prakalpa is a globally acclaimed conditional cash transfer scheme awarded by the United Nations Public Service Forum. Implemented across West Bengal, it aims to prevent early child marriages of girls and incentivize their education. It has two components: K1 provides an annual scholarship of ₹1,000 to unmarried adolescent girls aged 13 to 18 enrolled in Classes 8 to 12; K2 provides a one-time grant of ₹25,000 to unmarried girls turning 18 who are pursuing higher education, vocational training, or technical courses.
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) and one-time cash grant of ₹25,000 (K2) credited directly into the girl's independent bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of the girl student
Birth certificate issued by municipal / panchayat authority
School/College bonafide certificate with enrollment details
Declaration of unmarried status certified by parents/head of institution
application_process: 1. Obtain Kanyashree form (K1 or K2) free of cost from your school or college. 2. Submit filled form with birth certificate and bank details to the school headmaster. 3. School enters data into the Kanyashree online portal (wbkanyashree.gov.in). 4. District administration approves and transfers funds directly to the student's account.
source_name: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal

name: Swasthya Sathi Scheme
department: Department of Health and Family Welfare
description: Universal cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year, issued in the name of the female head of family in West Bengal.
detailed_description: Swasthya Sathi is a universal health insurance scheme launched by the Government of West Bengal, covering nearly the entire resident population of the state. It provides comprehensive cashless medical and surgical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare in empaneled private and government hospitals. As a policy of women empowerment, the Smart Card is issued in the name of the eldest female member of the family.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, day care surgeries, diagnostic investigations, consultations, and medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Swasthya Sathi Smart Card (photographed and biometric-verified)
application_process: 1. Enroll during 'Duare Sarkar' outreach camps or submit Form B at the local Block Development Office / Municipality. 2. Eldest female member of the family presents biometric data and photograph. 3. Receive the chip-based Swasthya Sathi Smart Card. 4. Present card at empaneled hospitals for immediate cashless treatment.
source_name: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal

name: Orunodoi 2.0 Scheme
description: Monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹1,250 directly into the bank accounts of female heads of economically disadvantaged families in Assam.
detailed_description: Orunodoi (Arunodoi) is Assam's largest direct benefit transfer initiative, administered by the Finance Department. It provides monthly subsistence support of ₹1,250 directly into the bank accounts of nominated female heads of low-income families. The scheme prioritizes households with widows, unmarried women, divorced women, persons with disabilities, and destitute individuals to ensure household food security, essential nutrition, and purchase of medicines.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 deposited directly into the female beneficiary's bank account via DBT on the 10th of every month.
documents: Aadhaar card of the female beneficiary
Disability certificate / Widow certificate (if applicable for priority scoring)
application_process: 1. Beneficiaries are surveyed and identified through Gaon Panchayat and VCDC verification teams. 2. Eligible women submit application forms and complete biometric e-KYC. 3. District Level Monitoring Committee approves beneficiary rolls. 4. Funds are transferred monthly via DBT.
source_name: Finance Department, Government of Assam

name: Mukhya Mantri Lok Sevak Arogya Yojana (MMLSAY) / Ayushman Asom
description: Cashless medical treatment cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled hospitals across Assam and India.
detailed_description: Ayushman Asom (Mukhya Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) and MMLSAY provide comprehensive cashless health assurance for families residing in Assam. Ayushman Asom covers ration card holder families with cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year, converging with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Beneficiaries can access free hospitalization across 300+ network hospitals in Assam and premier hospitals nationwide.
benefits: Cashless inpatient hospitalization, specialized surgeries, oncology treatments, diagnostics, and ICU care up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Assam National Food Security Act (NFSA) Ration Card
application_process: 1. NFSA cardholders can generate their Ayushman Asom card via beneficiary.nha.gov.in or at any Common Service Centre. 2. Present card and Aadhaar at the Ayushman Mitra desk in any network hospital. 3. Pre-authorization is approved electronically. 4. Receive 100% cashless treatment.
source_name: State Health Agency, Government of Assam

name: Pragyan Bharati Scheme
description: Free scooties (two-wheelers) for meritorious Class 12 students, along with free college admissions and textbook stipends in Assam.
detailed_description: Pragyan Bharati is an educational empowerment scheme executed by the Higher Education Department, Government of Assam. Under the Anundoram Borooah and Banikanta Kakati awards under this scheme, meritorious female students securing 60%+ marks and male students securing 75%+ marks in the Higher Secondary (Class 12) examinations of AHSEC are awarded free scooties (petrol or electric) to facilitate university commuting. The scheme also provides free college admission waivers and textbook allowances for undergraduate students.
benefits: Award of a free two-wheeler scooty (petrol or e-scooty) for meritorious Class 12 graduates, free college admission waivers, and ₹1,000 annual textbook grant.
documents: AHSEC Class 12 Marksheet and Admit Card
Two-wheeler learner's license / driving license (for scooty registration)
application_process: 1. AHSEC Class 12 meritorious students (girls securing 60%+ and boys securing 75%+) log into the Pragyan Bharati portal (directorateofhighereducation.assam.gov.in) during the annual application window. 2. Choose preferred two-wheeler variant (petrol or electric). 3. Upload HS marksheet, admit card, and learner's/driving license. 4. Scooties are formally distributed at designated district ceremonies.
source_name: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Assam

name: Chief Minister's Arogya Arunachal Yojana (CMAAY)
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for tertiary and secondary medical treatments for residents of Arunachal Pradesh.
detailed_description: Chief Minister's Arogya Arunachal Yojana (CMAAY) is a state health protection scheme implemented by the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Arunachal Pradesh. It converges with PM-JAY to provide cashless hospital care up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year. The scheme covers indigenous APST (Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe) residents, non-APST government employees, and state residents through a wide network of empaneled public and private hospitals across the Northeast and mainland India.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, consultations, and post-discharge medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate or Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC)
application_process: 1. Register online on the CMAAY portal (cmaay.com) or at the District Hospital CMAAY Kiosk. 2. Submit APST certificate or PRC along with Aadhaar details. 3. Receive the CMAAY Health Card. 4. Produce the card at any empaneled hospital for instant cashless admission.
source_name: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Arunachal Pradesh

name: Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana
description: Zero-percent (0%) effective interest crop loans via state interest subvention of 4% for farmers availing Kisan Credit Card loans in Arunachal Pradesh.
detailed_description: Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana is an agricultural credit support scheme designed to make institutional credit affordable for farmers in Arunachal Pradesh. When farmers avail crop loans through Kisan Credit Cards (KCC) from Apex Bank, SBI, or commercial banks at the subsidized rate of 7%, the state government provides an additional 4% interest subvention on timely repayment (over and above the 3% central prompt repayment incentive), making the effective interest rate zero percent (0%).
benefits: Zero percent (0%) net interest on crop loans up to ₹3,00,000 via a 4% state interest subvention, reducing debt burden and boosting farm investments.
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) issued by the Deputy Commissioner
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) loan account passbook
application_process: 1. Approach your local bank branch (Arunachal Pradesh Rural Bank / State Apex Bank / SBI) with Land Possession Certificate. 2. Apply for a Kisan Credit Card (KCC) crop loan under CM Krishi Rinn Yojana. 3. Circle Officer / Agriculture Development Officer verifies land and farming activity. 4. Interest subvention is credited directly to the loan account on prompt repayment.
source_name: Department of Agriculture, Government of Arunachal Pradesh

name: Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT)
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization for vulnerable families in Manipur.
detailed_description: Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT) is a pioneering health protection scheme of the Government of Manipur. It provides cashless medical treatment to poor and vulnerable families, BPL families, widow-headed families, and disabled persons across Manipur. Beneficiaries receive cashless hospitalization cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for cardiovascular diseases, kidney diseases, neurosurgery, liver diseases, cancer, and burns in network hospitals.
benefits: Cashless medical and surgical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year, plus travel allowance of ₹300 per hospital visit (up to ₹1,000 per year).
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
BPL Ration Card / Antyodaya Card / Eligibility verification certificate from local SDO
application_process: 1. Enroll at special CMHT enrollment kiosks set up at District Hospitals, Community Health Centres, or online at cmhtmanipur.gov.in. 2. Submit BPL certificate and Aadhaar for verification. 3. Pay nominal card fee of ₹50 (free for AAY/widows/PWD). 4. Present CMHT Card at any empaneled hospital for cashless admission.
source_name: Directorate of Health Services, Government of Manipur

name: Chief Minister-gi Sotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST)
description: Monthly maintenance allowance of ₹1,500, free transport pass, and caregiver support for persons with severe disabilities in Manipur.
detailed_description: Chief Minister-gi Sotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST) is a dedicated social welfare program executed by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Manipur, to support Persons with Disabilities (PWDs). Beneficiaries with 80%+ benchmark disabilities receive a monthly maintenance allowance of ₹1,500 via DBT, free concession passes for state transport buses, assistive devices, soft loans with 50% capital subsidies for self-employment, and care-giver allowances.
benefits: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 via DBT, free mobility assistive devices (wheelchairs, tri-cycles, hearing aids), and free state travel passes.
documents: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / Medical Disability Certificate (minimum 80% disability)
Bank passbook in beneficiary's name (Aadhaar linked)
application_process: 1. Obtain application form from the District Social Welfare Office (DSWO) or download from socialwelfare.mn.gov.in. 2. Attach Unique Disability ID (UDID) card showing minimum 80% benchmark disability, Manipur domicile proof, and bank passbook. 3. Medical board and DSWO verify disability credentials. 4. Sanction is issued and monthly allowance of ₹1,500 is credited via DBT.
source_name: Social Welfare Department, Government of Manipur

name: Megha Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS Phase VI)
department: Department of Health and Family Welfare
description: Universal cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,30,000 per family per year for all residents of Meghalaya converged with PM-JAY.
detailed_description: Megha Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS) is a universal health insurance program implemented by the State Health Agency, Government of Meghalaya. It converges with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY to provide comprehensive cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover up to ₹5,30,000 per family per year on a family floater basis (₹5,00,000 under PM-JAY + ₹30,000 state top-up for diagnostic and critical illness support) across all empaneled hospitals.
benefits: Comprehensive cashless medical and surgical care up to ₹5,30,000 per family per year with no restriction on family size or age limit.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Meghalaya Ration Card / Electoral Photo Identity Card (EPIC)
application_process: 1. Visit the community enrollment camp organized in your village/locality or the District MHIS kiosk. 2. Submit EPIC/Aadhaar card for family registration. 3. Pay nominal card fee of ₹30 and receive MHIS Smart Card. 4. Present card at empaneled hospitals for complete cashless admission.
source_name: State Health Agency, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Meghalaya

name: FOCUS Scheme (Farmers Collectivization for Upscaling Production)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Direct financial assistance of ₹5,000 per farmer member (up to ₹1,00,000 per Producer Group) for agricultural scaling in Meghalaya.
detailed_description: FOCUS (Farmers' Collectivization for Upscaling of Production and Marketing Systems) is Meghalaya's flagship rural development and farming initiative. To overcome the challenges of small and fragmented landholdings in the hills, the scheme mobilizes small and marginal farmers into Producer Groups (PGs) of 10 to 20 members. Each member receives a direct seed capital grant of ₹5,000 (totaling ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 per group) for farm inputs, machinery, processing, and value addition.
benefits: Direct grant assistance of ₹5,000 per farmer member credited into the joint bank account of the registered Producer Group via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of all group members
Producer Group (PG) registration certificate and resolution
Joint bank account passbook of the Producer Group
Voter ID / Domicile proof in Meghalaya
application_process: 1. Form a Producer Group of 10 to 20 active farmers in your village. 2. Register the group through the Basin Development Unit (BDU) or online at focusmeghalaya.org. 3. Field coordinator inspects agricultural plan and approves registration. 4. Grant funds are transferred via DBT into the group's bank account.
source_name: Meghalaya Basin Development Authority (MBDA), Government of Meghalaya

name: Mizoram State Health Care Scheme (MSHCS)
description: Cashless medical reimbursement coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care for residents of Mizoram.
detailed_description: Mizoram State Health Care Scheme (MSHCS) is managed by the Mizoram State Health Care Society, Health and Family Welfare Department. It provides health insurance and medical reimbursement support up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for resident families of Mizoram not covered by central government employee schemes. It covers major inpatient surgical, oncological, and medical treatments in designated empaneled hospitals within and outside Mizoram.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization and medical treatment reimbursement up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on an annual renewable membership basis.
documents: Voter ID card / Family Ration Card
application_process: 1. Enroll during the annual enrollment window announced by the Mizoram State Health Care Society. 2. Submit family details and pay nominal annual membership contribution at the CMO office or online portal (mshcs.mizoram.gov.in). 3. Receive MSHCS Card. 4. Produce card at network hospitals for treatment coverage.
source_name: Mizoram State Health Care Society, Health and Family Welfare Department, Mizoram

name: Bana Kaih (Handholding Scheme)
description: Collateral-free and interest-free bank loans up to ₹50,00,000 with government guarantee for farmers, youth, and entrepreneurs in Mizoram.
detailed_description: Bana Kaih (Handholding Scheme) is a landmark economic development policy introduced by the Government of Mizoram. It empowers farmers, rural artisans, micro-enterprises, and educated unemployed youth by providing institutional credit without collateral. The state government acts as the guarantor for partner bank loans up to ₹50,00,000, covers 100% of the interest through state interest subvention, and establishes market linkages and minimum support prices for key agricultural crops.
benefits: Interest-free bank loans up to ₹50,00,000 with 100% government guarantee, technical mentoring, capacity building, and assured crop buy-backs.
documents: Aadhaar card and Voter ID card
Land lease / ownership document (for agricultural/infrastructure ventures)
application_process: 1. Apply online via the Bana Kaih handholding portal (planning.mizoram.gov.in) or submit concept note to the District Planning Officer. 2. Submit business proposal in approved focus sectors (agriculture, horticulture, food processing, or micro-enterprises). 3. Handholding Board and partner banks evaluate technical feasibility. 4. Bank loan up to ₹50,00,000 is sanctioned with 100% government guarantee and state interest subvention.
source_name: Planning & Programme Implementation Department, Government of Mizoram

name: Chief Minister's Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS)
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for citizens and up to ₹20,00,000 for employees in Nagaland.
detailed_description: Chief Minister's Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS) is a universal health insurance initiative implemented by the National Health Authority / State Health Agency of Nagaland. It is bifurcated into CMHIS (General) covering all indigenous and permanent resident families of Nagaland with cashless hospital treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year (converged with PM-JAY), and CMHIS (Employees & Pensioners) covering state government employees with cashless coverage up to ₹20,00,000 per family per year.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization, critical surgery, chemotherapy, and ICU care up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled hospitals across India.
documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate (IIC) / Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) of Nagaland
Aadhaar card of all family members
Ration Card or valid family identity document
application_process: 1. Register on the CMHIS portal (cmhis.nagaland.gov.in) or visit the District Hospital enrollment counter. 2. Upload Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate and family Aadhaar details. 3. Complete e-KYC and download CMHIS Card. 4. Present card at empaneled network hospitals for instant cashless hospitalization.
source_name: Nagaland Health Authority, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Nagaland

name: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative (CMMFI)
department: Department of Agriculture / Planning and Transformation
description: Subsidized bank loans up to ₹15,00,000 with 30% capital subsidy and 4% interest subvention for farmers and entrepreneurs in Nagaland.
detailed_description: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative (CMMFI) is an economic empowerment program implemented by the Government of Nagaland in partnership with commercial banks. It facilitates credit access for farmers, Self Help Groups (SHGs), Joint Liability Groups (JLGs), and youth entrepreneurs in agriculture, horticulture, animal husbandry, agro-processing, and micro-enterprises. The scheme provides a back-ended capital subsidy of 30% and an interest subvention of 4% per annum for prompt repayment.
benefits: Credit access up to ₹15,00,000 per beneficiary with a 30% back-ended capital investment subsidy and 4% interest subvention for up to 5 years.
documents: Detailed project report (DPR) / Quotation of machinery or farm equipment
application_process: 1. Apply online through the CMMFI portal (cmmfi.nagaland.gov.in) or submit application to the District Level Implementation Committee (DLIC) headed by the Deputy Commissioner. 2. DLIC screens proposals and forwards recommended applicants to partner banks. 3. Bank sanctions loan and capital subsidy is deposited into the reserve fund account.
source_name: Planning and Transformation Department, Government of Nagaland

name: Chief Minister Jan Arogya Yojana (CM-JAY Tripura)
description: Universal cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled hospitals across Tripura.
detailed_description: Chief Minister Jan Arogya Yojana (CM-JAY Tripura) is a universal health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Tripura. Modeled on the lines of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, it extends cashless health coverage to all resident families of Tripura who were left out of PM-JAY (including state government employees, pensioners, and middle-income families). It provides cashless inpatient hospitalization up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in all empaneled government and private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization and surgical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 1,949 clinical packages in empaneled hospitals.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Tripura Ration Card / Permanent Resident Certificate (PRTC)
application_process: 1. Verify your name and family details on the CM-JAY portal or at any Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Submit Aadhaar and ration card for e-KYC. 3. Download the CM-JAY Health Card. 4. Produce card at network hospitals for cashless treatment.
source_name: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Tripura

name: Mukhyamantri Matru Pusti Uphaar
department: Social Welfare and Social Education Department
description: Free nutritional food kits containing ghee, pulses, soybean, and supplements for pregnant and lactating mothers after ANC checkups in Tripura.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Matru Pusti Uphaar is a maternal nutrition and infant health scheme executed by the Social Welfare and Social Education Department of Tripura. Under this initiative, pregnant women undergoing regular Antenatal Care (ANC) checkups at Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and Community Health Centres receive a free nutritional kit after each trimester. The kit includes pure ghee, soybean, pulses, jaggery, chikki, and protein health supplements to eradicate maternal anemia and malnutrition.
benefits: Nutritional kits worth ₹500 distributed 4 times during pregnancy after each routine ANC checkup, supporting mother and child health.
documents: Aadhaar card of the pregnant woman
ANC registration slip from Government PHC / CHC
application_process: 1. Register pregnancy at the local Anganwadi Centre or Primary Health Centre (PHC). 2. Receive MCP Card and attend scheduled routine ANC checkups. 3. Medical Officer stamps ANC completion on MCP card. 4. Receive the free nutrition kit over-the-counter at the health facility.
source_name: Social Welfare and Social Education Department, Government of Tripura

name: Mukhya Mantri Awas Yojana (Sikkim)
description: Financial grant of ₹4,00,000 to construct durable, earthquake-resilient single-storey pucca houses for poor rural families in Sikkim.
detailed_description: Mukhya Mantri Awas Yojana (MMAY Sikkim) is a state housing initiative executed by the Rural Development Department, Government of Sikkim. It aims to eliminate kutcha, thatched, and dilapidated dwellings across rural Sikkim by providing financial assistance of ₹4,00,000 per family to construct an earthquake-resilient, single-storey RCC framed pucca house with a living room, bedroom, kitchen, and attached toilet.
benefits: Direct grant of ₹4,00,000 disbursed in construction-linked stages directly via DBT, enabling complete construction of a permanent pucca home.
documents: Sikkim Certificate of Identification (COI) / Residential Certificate
Aadhaar card of head of household
Land ownership parcha / Land possession certificate
Gram Sabha resolution and BPL / kutcha house certificate
application_process: 1. Beneficiaries are identified and prioritized during annual Gram Sabha village meetings based on kutcha house and homeless status. 2. Block Development Officer (BDO) and junior engineers conduct field inspections and geo-tagging of the proposed construction site. 3. Sanction order of ₹4,00,000 is issued by the Rural Development Department. 4. Grant installments are released directly to bank accounts via DBT linked to construction milestones.
source_name: Rural Development Department, Government of Sikkim

name: Sikkim Aama Yojana
description: Annual financial grant of ₹20,000 directly deposited into the bank accounts of non-working, unemployed mothers in Sikkim.
detailed_description: Sikkim Aama Yojana is a dedicated welfare program implemented by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Sikkim. It recognizes the vital caregiving and domestic contributions of non-working, unemployed mothers residing in Sikkim who have no formal source of income. Eligible mothers aged 18 to 60 years receive an annual financial assistance grant of ₹20,000 deposited directly into their savings bank accounts via DBT.
benefits: Annual financial assistance of ₹20,000 credited directly into the mother's bank account via DBT to ensure personal financial autonomy.
documents: Certificate of Identification (COI) / Sikkim Subject Certificate
Aadhaar card and Voter ID card of the mother
Child birth certificate / Family composition certificate
Self-declaration of unemployment and non-government employee status
application_process: 1. Non-working, unemployed mothers collect application form from the local Gram Panchayat Unit (GPU) or Child Development Project Officer (CDPO). 2. Attach Sikkim Certificate of Identification (COI), Aadhaar card, child birth certificate, and unemployment declaration. 3. GPU and WCD verification committee verify non-employment status. 4. Annual financial assistance of ₹20,000 is credited via DBT.
source_name: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Sikkim

name: Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana (Sarbat Sehat Bima Yojana - SSBY)
department: Department of Health and Family Welfare
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare in Punjab.
detailed_description: Sarbat Sehat Bima Yojana (SSBY) is Punjab's flagship cashless health insurance scheme, implemented by the State Health Agency Punjab in convergence with PM-JAY. It covers over 75% of Punjab's population including NFSA smart ration card holders, J-Form farmers, registered small traders, construction workers, and accredited journalists. Beneficiaries receive cashless hospitalization and surgical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in 900+ empaneled hospitals.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization, diagnostic services, surgeries, and daycare treatments up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Punjab Smart Ration Card / J-Form (for farmers) / BOCW registration card
application_process: 1. Check eligibility on the SSBY portal (shapunjab.in) or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) / Market Committee. 2. Verify Aadhaar and family details to generate the SSBY e-Card. 3. Present card at the Arogyamitra desk in any empaneled hospital for cashless admission.
source_name: State Health Agency, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Punjab

name: Ashirwad Scheme (formerly Shagun Scheme)
department: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities
description: One-time financial grant of ₹51,000 for the marriage of adult daughters of SC, BC, and economically weaker families in Punjab.
detailed_description: Ashirwad Scheme (formerly Shagun Scheme) is a social assistance program implemented by the Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Government of Punjab. It assists low-income parents from Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, Christian, Muslim communities, and economically weaker sections with their daughters' wedding expenses. Eligible families receive a one-time grant of ₹51,000 transferred directly into the beneficiary's bank account.
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹51,000 deposited directly into the beneficiary's bank account via DBT before or at the time of marriage.
documents: Aadhaar card of bride and groom
Age proof verifying bride is 18+ and groom is 21+
Income certificate (annual family income up to ₹32,790)
application_process: 1. Apply online via the Punjab State Citizen Portal (punjab.gov.in) or visit the nearest Sewa Kendra / District Social Justice Office. 2. Submit application at least 30 days prior to marriage or within 30 days post-marriage with age proof (bride 18+, groom 21+), income certificate (under ₹32,790/yr), caste certificate (SC/BC/Minority), and bank passbook. 3. District Welfare Officer verifies records. 4. Grant of ₹51,000 is disbursed via DBT.
source_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Government of Punjab

name: Chirayu Haryana (Ayushman Bharat - Chirayu)
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for families with verified annual income up to ₹3,00,000 in Haryana.
detailed_description: Chirayu Haryana (Comprehensive Health Insurance Action for Resilient Health Care) is an expanded health protection initiative implemented by the State Health Authority Haryana. Families enrolled in the Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) with verified annual family income up to ₹1,80,000 receive 100% free premium coverage, while families earning between ₹1,80,000 and ₹3,00,000 can enroll by paying a nominal annual contribution of ₹1,500. It provides cashless medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 1,500+ procedures.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, consultations, and medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled hospitals.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
application_process: 1. Check your family status on the Chirayu portal (chirayuayushmanharyana.in) using your PPP Family ID. 2. Families in the ₹1.8L–₹3L bracket make nominal online payment of ₹1,500. 3. Download the Chirayu Ayushman Card from the portal or collect at nearest CSC. 4. Present card at empaneled hospitals for instant cashless treatment.
source_name: State Health Authority Haryana, Health Department, Government of Haryana

name: Mukhyamantri Parivar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY)
department: Directorate of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year for low-income families in Haryana to pay premiums for central social security and pension schemes.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Parivar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY) is a social security umbrella initiative of the Government of Haryana. It covers families with verified annual income up to ₹1,80,000 and landholding up to 5 acres in Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). The state deposits ₹6,000 annually into the family head's bank account, which is automatically utilized to pay annual insurance and pension premiums for PMJJBY (life insurance), PMSBY (accident insurance), and PM-SYM / PM-KMY (old age pension), with the balance amount available for family welfare.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year per eligible family, fully funding life insurance, accidental cover, and pension contributions with remaining balance in cash.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Bank passbook details with auto-debit consent
application_process: 1. Register on the MMPSY portal (mmpsy.haryana.gov.in) using your Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 2. Select preferred insurance and pension scheme combinations for family members. 3. Sign auto-debit bank mandate. 4. Annual financial benefit of ₹6,000 is credited via DBT and premium deductions executed automatically.
source_name: Directorate of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana

name: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana
department: Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department
description: Financial wedding grant of ₹31,000 to ₹71,000 for daughters of BPL families, SC/ST widows, and divyang couples in Haryana.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana is executed by the Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department, Haryana. It provides financial wedding grants to poor families. BPL families belonging to Scheduled Castes and destitute widows receive ₹71,000 (₹66,000 before marriage, ₹5,000 upon submitting marriage certificate). Other BPL and backward class families receive ₹31,000 to ₹51,000. Couples where both partners have disabilities receive ₹51,000.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹71,000 deposited directly into the newly married daughter's bank account via DBT.
documents: Aadhaar card of bride and groom
BPL card / PPP verified income certificate (annual income up to ₹1,80,000)
Marriage invitation card and marriage registration certificate
application_process: 1. Apply online on the Saral Haryana portal (saralharyana.gov.in) before marriage or within 6 months of wedding. 2. Enter PPP ID and upload required age, income, and marriage documents. 3. District Welfare Officer verifies records. 4. Shagun grant is disbursed directly via DBT into the bride's bank account.
source_name: Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department, Government of Haryana

name: Himcare Scheme (Himachal Health Care Scheme)
department: Department of Health and Family Welfare
description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for residents of Himachal Pradesh not covered under PM-JAY.
detailed_description: Himcare Scheme is a state-funded health protection program launched by the Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide universal health coverage to residents not covered under Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY). It covers families holding valid state ration cards with cashless inpatient hospital care up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis for secondary and tertiary care in empaneled government and private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical procedures, diagnostics, and post-discharge medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Category proof (BPL certificate / Street Vendor ID / Anganwadi worker certificate, if claiming free premium)
application_process: 1. Register on the official portal (hpsha.in) or visit any Lok Mitra Kendra / CSC in Himachal Pradesh. 2. Enter Ration Card details and upload Aadhaar cards of family members. 3. Pay applicable nominal annual fee (free for BPL/street vendors/PWD; ₹365 to ₹1,000 for other categories). 4. Download Himcare Card and present at empaneled hospitals for cashless treatment.
source_name: State Health Agency, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Himachal Pradesh

name: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi Yojana
description: Direct monthly financial grant of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 annually) to adult women aged 18 to 59 years residing in Himachal Pradesh.
detailed_description: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi Yojana is a social security and economic empowerment initiative implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh. Under this scheme, eligible women permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh between the ages of 18 and 59 receive monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 deposited directly into their bank accounts via DBT. Women in families where no member is a government employee or income-tax payer are eligible.
benefits: Monthly cash assistance of ₹1,500 credited directly into the woman's savings bank account via DBT on a monthly basis.
documents: Self-declaration confirming no family member is in regular government service or pays income tax
application_process: 1. Collect application form from the local Tehsil Welfare Officer (TWO) or download from himachal.nic.in. 2. Fill form and attach Bonafide certificate, Aadhaar, and bank passbook. 3. Submit application to the Tehsil Welfare Officer or Gram Panchayat Secretary. 4. Monthly grant of ₹1,500 is disbursed directly to the bank account via DBT.
source_name: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh

name: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana
description: Universal cashless healthcare coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for all resident families of Uttarakhand.
detailed_description: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana is a universal health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Uttarakhand. It provides cashless medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis for secondary and tertiary care across empaneled public and private hospitals. The scheme covers all resident families of Uttarakhand holding NFSA ration cards, state ration cards, or voter identification, leaving no family behind.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, consultations, and medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Uttarakhand Ration Card (NFSA / State White / Yellow / Pink Card)
application_process: 1. Check your name on the Ayushman Uttarakhand portal (ayushmanuttarakhand.org) or at any Common Service Centre. 2. Verify biometric credentials and generate the Golden Card. 3. Present Golden Card at any empaneled hospital for instant cashless admission.
source_name: State Health Agency, Government of Uttarakhand

name: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Yojana
department: Women Empowerment and Child Development Department
description: Nutritional care and newborn hygiene kit for mothers giving birth to a girl child (up to first two daughters) in Uttarakhand.
detailed_description: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Yojana is a maternal and infant welfare initiative implemented by the Women Empowerment and Child Development Department of Uttarakhand. It aims to eliminate gender bias, celebrate the birth of girl children, and improve postnatal health. Mothers giving birth to a girl child in institutional healthcare facilities receive a comprehensive Mahalakshmi Kit containing dry fruits, clothes, blankets, baby hygiene essentials, nutritional supplements, and baby care items.
benefits: Comprehensive maternal and newborn kit containing nutrition (almonds, walnuts, ghee), woolen blankets, baby clothes, towels, sanitary napkins, and baby hygiene kit.
documents: Aadhaar card of mother and father
Institutional birth discharge slip showing birth of girl child
application_process: 1. In-kind maternal nutrition and newborn hygiene scheme; no separate commercial web form. 2. Following institutional delivery of a girl child in a government or accredited private hospital, submit hospital birth discharge slip and MCP card to the local Anganwadi worker. 3. Anganwadi worker registers the birth of the first or second daughter. 4. The Mahalakshmi Kit is formally handed over to the mother at the health facility or Anganwadi Centre.
source_name: Women Empowerment and Child Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand

name: Delhi Free Electricity Scheme
description: 100% subsidy (zero electricity bill) on monthly consumption up to 200 units and 50% subsidy up to 400 units for domestic consumers in Delhi.
detailed_description: Delhi Free Electricity Scheme is a landmark energy subsidy initiative executed by the Department of Power, Government of NCT of Delhi, through distribution DISCOMs (BSES Rajdhani, BSES Yamuna, TPDDL). Domestic consumers consuming up to 200 units of electricity per month receive a 100% subsidy, resulting in a zero electricity bill. Consumers consuming between 201 and 400 units receive a 50% subsidy (up to ₹800 per month). Consumers opt-in annually via digital or paper consent.
benefits: Zero electricity bill (100% power subsidy) for monthly consumption up to 200 units, and 50% subsidy up to ₹800 for consumption between 201 and 400 units.
documents: Electricity bill showing CA number (Consumer Account number)
Active mobile number for receiving OTP
application_process: 1. To avail 100% subsidy (zero bill) on monthly power consumption up to 200 units, Delhi domestic consumers must opt-in annually. 2. Submit opt-in consent by giving a missed call to 7011311111, sending a WhatsApp message to the official Delhi Government power number, or logging into your DISCOM portal (BSES Rajdhani/Yamuna at bsesdelhi.com, or Tata Power DDL at tatapower-ddl.com). 3. Enter your CA number. 4. Subsidy is applied automatically to monthly billing cycles.
source_name: Department of Power, Government of NCT of Delhi

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
description: Financial deposits of ₹11,000 at birth and ₹5,000 at five school admission milestones for girl children in Delhi, maturing at age 18.
detailed_description: Delhi Ladli Scheme is an educational empowerment and female welfare scheme implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of NCT of Delhi, in collaboration with SBI Life Insurance. It provides periodic financial deposits in the name of the girl child: ₹11,000 if born in an institutional hospital (or ₹10,000 for home birth), and ₹5,000 each upon admission to Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, Class 10, and Class 12. The accumulated funds with compound interest mature when the girl attains 18 years and passes Class 10.
benefits: Periodic deposits totaling ₹35,000 to ₹36,000 invested with compounding interest, providing a substantial maturity corpus at age 18 to fund higher education.
documents: Aadhaar card of girl child and parents
Delhi residence proof (minimum 3 years residence in Delhi)
Birth certificate of the girl child
Family income certificate (annual income up to ₹1,00,000)
School admission certificate / Fee receipt (for school stages)
application_process: 1. Collect application form from the recognized school upon admission (Classes 1, 6, 9, 10, 12) or from the District WCD office (for institutional birth stage). 2. Attach proof of 3-year Delhi residence, income certificate (up to ₹1,00,000/yr), birth certificate, and school admission receipt. 3. School headmaster / WCD officer verifies records and registers child with SBI Life Insurance. 4. Deposit certificates mature when girl turns 18 and passes Class 10.
source_name: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of NCT of Delhi

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT
description: Universal cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for all residents of Jammu and Kashmir.
detailed_description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT (Social, Endeavour for Health and Telemedicine) is a historic universal healthcare initiative launched by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir. Unlike other states where only BPL families are covered, SEHAT extends 100% cashless health insurance up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year to all permanent residents and families of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir on a floater basis across thousands of empaneled hospitals nationwide.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization, surgical care, diagnostic tests, consultations, and medicines up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis across India.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Jammu & Kashmir Ration Card / Domicile Certificate
application_process: 1. Visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) in J&K or access beneficiary.nha.gov.in. 2. Submit Ration Card or Domicile Certificate and Aadhaar for biometric verification. 3. Download the SEHAT Golden Card. 4. Produce card at any empaneled hospital across India for cashless care.
source_name: State Health Agency, Health and Medical Education Department, J&K

name: Mumkin Scheme (Mission Youth J&K)
description: Livelihood program providing commercial small transport vehicles with 20% financial contribution/subsidy for unemployed youth in J&K.
detailed_description: Mumkin Scheme is a flagship livelihood initiative executed by Mission Youth, Government of Jammu and Kashmir. It facilitates self-employment for educated unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 by helping them acquire commercial small vehicles (mini-trucks, pick-up vans, passenger cabs). Mission Youth contributes 10% of the on-road vehicle cost (or ₹80,000), vehicle manufacturers provide a matching 10% upfront discount, and partner banks finance the remaining 80% with zero collateral.
benefits: 100% on-road commercial vehicle purchase financing with a 20% non-repayable capital margin (10% state grant + 10% manufacturer discount) with no mortgage.
documents: Unemployment certificate issued by District Employment and Counseling Centre
application_process: 1. Apply online through the Mission Youth portal (missionyouth.jk.gov.in) or J&K Single Window System. 2. Upload driving license, educational proof, and unemployment declaration. 3. District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) headed by the Deputy Commissioner screens and interviews candidates. 4. Vehicle is handed over upon bank sanction.
source_name: Mission Youth, Government of Jammu and Kashmir

name: Ladakh Rewa Scheme
description: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to ₹1,54,000 for meritorious students from Ladakh who qualify prestigious competitive entrance exams.
detailed_description: Rewa Scheme (Financial Assistance to Meritorious Students) is an education support initiative of the Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Councils (LAHDC Leh and Kargil) and the Department of Higher Education, UT Administration of Ladakh. It assists meritorious students of Ladakh who clear national-level competitive examinations (such as NEET UG, JEE Advanced, UPSC Civil Services Prelims, GATE). Beneficiaries receive a direct financial award of up to ₹1,54,000 to fund professional coaching and initial university expenses.
benefits: One-time cash incentive of ₹1,00,000 for clearing national medical/engineering entrance exams and up to ₹1,54,000 for clearing UPSC Prelims.
documents: Resident Certificate of Ladakh / Ladakh ST Certificate
Exam admit card, scorecard, and qualifying result notification
Proof of admission / Coaching enrollment receipt
application_process: 1. Apply through the LAHDC Leh / Kargil portal (ladakh.nic.in) upon publication of qualifying exam results. 2. Upload qualifying scorecard and Ladakh resident certificate. 3. Education committee scrutinizes claims. 4. Award amount is credited directly into the student's bank account via DBT.
source_name: Department of Higher Education / LAHDC, UT Administration of Ladakh

name: Chandigarh Disability Pension Scheme
description: Monthly disability pension of ₹2,000 to persons with 40%+ permanent disabilities residing in the Union Territory of Chandigarh.
detailed_description: The Disability Pension Scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh Administration. It provides financial sustenance of ₹2,00,00 per month to permanent residents of UT Chandigarh with benchmark disabilities of 40% or more (including blindness, locomotor disability, hearing impairment, mental illness) whose family income does not exceed ₹1,50,000 per annum.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 credited directly into the beneficiary's savings bank account via DBT.
documents: Chandigarh Residence Proof (minimum 3 years residence in UT Chandigarh)
Disability Certificate / UDID Card showing minimum 40% disability from Government Medical College Hospital (GMCH-32 or GMSH-16)
Family income certificate (annual income up to ₹1,50,000)
Bank passbook details with IFSC code
application_process: 1. Apply online via the Chandigarh Administration citizen service portal (chdservices.gov.in) or visit the nearest Sampark Centre. 2. Submit medical disability certificate and proof of 3-year residence in Chandigarh. 3. Social Welfare Officer verifies credentials. 4. Monthly pension is sanctioned and credited via DBT.
source_name: Department of Social Welfare, Chandigarh Administration

name: Old Age Pension Scheme Puducherry
description: Monthly financial pension of ₹2,000 to ₹3,500 for destitute senior citizens aged 60 and above residing in the UT of Puducherry.
detailed_description: Old Age Pension Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. It provides monthly subsistence pensions to destitute elderly citizens aged 60 and above across all four regions (Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam) who have no regular source of income or family support. Beneficiaries aged 60 to 79 receive ₹2,000 per month, while those aged 80 and above receive ₹3,500 per month directly via DBT.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 (age 60–79) and ₹3,500 (age 80+) transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account via DBT.
documents: Puducherry Domicile / Nativity Certificate (minimum 5 years residence)
Ration Card of Puducherry (Red / Yellow Card)
Bank passbook details with Aadhaar seeding
application_process: 1. Obtain application form from the Directorate of Social Welfare, Puducherry, or download from socwelfare.py.gov.in. 2. Submit form with 5-year nativity certificate, age proof (60+), Puducherry ration card, and bank passbook to the Anganwadi worker or Field Welfare Officer. 3. Social Welfare Department conducts field inquiry. 4. Sanctioned pension of ₹2,000 (age 60–79) or ₹3,500 (age 80+) is disbursed monthly via DBT.
source_name: Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry

name: Lieutenant Governor's Higher Education Scholarship (Andaman)
description: Annual scholarship of ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 for local students from Andaman & Nicobar pursuing higher and professional education on the mainland.
detailed_description: The Lieutenant Governor's Higher Education Financial Assistance Scheme is administered by the Directorate of Higher Education, Andaman and Nicobar Administration. It supports local island students who secure admission in recognized universities and professional institutions on mainland India for engineering, medical, law, and degree courses. The scheme provides annual scholarships covering mainland tuition fees, book grants, and hostel living stipends.
benefits: Annual financial grant of ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 per academic year towards college tuition fees and hostel boarding on the mainland.
documents: Local Island Certificate / Resident Certificate of A&N Islands
College admission confirmation letter, fee structure, and hostel admission slip
Family income certificate (annual income up to ₹6,00,000)
application_process: 1. Apply online through the Andaman and Nicobar Administration portal (andaman.gov.in) or submit application to Directorate of Higher Education, Port Blair. 2. Upload Class 12 marksheets, local island resident certificate, mainland university admission letter, fee structure, and hostel admission slip. 3. Directorate of Higher Education verifies credentials. 4. Scholarship grant of ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000/year is credited directly into the student's bank account via DBT.
source_name: Directorate of Higher Education, Andaman and Nicobar Administration

name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana
ministry: U.T. Administration of DNH and DD
description: 100% free education, fee waivers, free uniforms, and textbook allowances for girl students from Class 1 to 12 across DNH & DD.
detailed_description: Saraswati Vidya Yojana is an educational welfare scheme executed by the Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. To promote girl child schooling and eliminate female dropouts, the administration provides 100% free education to all female students enrolled in Government and Government-aided schools from Class 1 to 12. Beneficiaries receive complete school fee waivers, free textbooks, two sets of uniforms, school bags, and stationery grants.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
benefits: Complete waiver of all school tuition, admission, and exam fees, free textbooks, school bags, uniforms, and bicycle grants for secondary classes.
documents: Aadhaar card of the female student and parents
School admission record / Bonafide certificate from headmaster
Bank passbook details (for DBT textbook and uniform allowances)
application_process: 1. Female students enrolled in any government or aided school in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu are enrolled automatically. 2. School headmaster submits student roster to the Directorate of Education. 3. Free stationery and uniforms are distributed at the school, and financial allowances credited via DBT.
source_name: Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

name: Lakshadweep Fisheries Subsidy and Boat Assistance Scheme
description: Up to 50% capital subsidy on outboard marine engines, modern fishing gear, and high-speed diesel for traditional fishers in Lakshadweep.
detailed_description: The Fisheries Subsidy and Modernization Scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries, Lakshadweep Administration. Given that marine fishing and tuna harvesting are the economic lifelines of the Lakshadweep archipelago, the scheme provides up to 50% capital subsidy for the procurement of inboard and outboard marine motors, modern GPS fish-finders, life-saving equipment, specialized pole-and-line tuna fishing gear, and subsidized high-speed diesel (HSD) to registered traditional fishermen.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on marine engines and craft modernization, subsidized diesel fuel, and free distribution of safety life jackets and GPS navigation units.
documents: Fisherman Biometric ID Card / Marine Fishing Registration Certificate
Fishing boat registration number and sea-worthiness certificate
application_process: 1. Submit application to the Fisheries Officer at the respective Island Fisheries Office. 2. Attach boat registration certificate, biometric ID, and gear quotation. 3. Island Technical Committee inspects vessel. 4. Subsidy is sanctioned and credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
source_name: Department of Fisheries, Lakshadweep Administration
